At DJS-AbbVie, we are committed to advancing new therapeutics and translating novel immunological science into innovative R&D programs. * Troubleshooting and execution of co-cultures and complex *in vitro* model systems
* Work as a key member of the Oxford immunobiology team but collaborating and working on whatever project is necessary to advance our therapeutic programs.

* Day-to-day laboratory management as part of the team e.g. maintaining a safe and clean working laboratory environment, re-ordering laboratory consumables
* Establishing and maintaining quality sample archives
* Gathering, analysing and presenting data from a variety of sources to the Oxford team as well as to US-based colleagues.
* Critical and impartial review of self and peer generated laboratory data
* Maintenance of laboratory experimental records
Qualifications

* Enthusiasm for and commitment to drug discovery and drug development research
* Proven recent experience in
+ Mammalian cell culture
+ Cell biology techniques (such as flow cytometry; ELISA; fluorescence microscopy)
* Evidence of excellent organizational and interpersonal skis including

+ Ability to work efficiently with strong attention to detail

**Senior Data Science Model Validation Specialist**
**The Role**
As a Model Validation Senior Specialist, you will be responsible for independently validating some of our most complex and high‐impact models across the business. These models range from traditional statistical pricing models through to advanced Machine Learning and Predictive AI models. You spend a significant proportion of their time performing deep technical validation activities, including rebuilding models, conducting challenger analysis, and critically assessing modelling approaches. In addition to hands-on validation, the role carries responsibility for maintaining high validation standards, contributing to validation framework development, and ensuring robust independent challenge across the model landscape.
We are looking for Model Validation Senior Specialists to work closely with our Pricing Data Science teams, as well as contributing to wider initiatives including Model Risk Management (MRM) framework development, model lifecycle governance, and the integration of validation practices into our evolving AI and MLOps strategy. This role will sit within our Motor Pricing landscape, and the responsibilities will cover all models aligned to our Pricing stream, including price-affecting models for risk & retail, identification of application fraud, and the building of risk indexes for post-sale analysis.
**About You**
We are looking for a highly skilled, technically strong individuals who thrives on deep analytical challenge and independent thinking. You will be passionate about Data Science, Machine Learning and Model Risk Management, and motivated to challenge, improve, and enhance modelling practices across the organisation.
You will be hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable working at depth — from independently reviewing data to rebuilding models and challenging methodological decisions. You will be business-focused, understanding the commercial implications of models, and able to balance technical rigour with practical outcomes. You will also have the confidence and credibility to challenge experienced Data Scientists and influence stakeholders across technical and non-technical audiences across the Group.
**Essential Skills & Experience**
* Significant experience in Data Science, Machine learning or Pricing Model Validations. Strong hands-on experience with Predictive modelling (pricing or risk models preferred), Machine Learning and AI techniques and challenger model development. Experience in leading independent end-to-end validation of models, covering:
+ Conceptual soundness and methodology
+ Data integrity, assumptions and selection
+ Model training, testing, and performance evaluation
+ Model assumptions, limitations, and stability
+ Deployment, monitoring, and business impact
* Building ML, AI / Pricing independent challenger models for high materiality / high-risk models, using alternative techniques where appropriate.
* Providing robust, evidence-based challenge to Data Science and Pricing teams, ensuring models are fit for purpose. Assess advanced modelling techniques, including Machine Learning models (e.g. GBM, Random Forest, XGBoost), Neural Networks and deep learning approaches and predictive AI models.
* Producing high-quality validation reports, clearly articulating key findings, risks, limitations, assumptions, recommendations and validation outcomes. Working in collaboration with Responsible AI team on Ethics assessments.
* Contributing to the development of Model validation standards and frameworks, MRM policies / best practices and on the AI / Model Risk integration and future capability.
**Desirable Skills and Experience**
* A strong academic background and a degree in a quantitative field (e.g., mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering or machine learning) with a preference for candidates holding a postgraduate degree or PhD.
* Proficient in Python, R, SQL (advanced level), ML libraries (e.g. scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch. Pandas and NumPy for data manipulation). Experience with Cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure) and model lifecycle tools / workflows (e.g. Jira, Calibra or similar).
* Strong understanding of Model validation techniques, MRM best practices, Statistical modelling, models performance evaluation, explainability and interpretability.
* Develop deep understanding of Admiral’s Pricing models and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers to improve our modelling capabilities.

## We are looking for highly motivated, curious individuals to help continue with our growth and continued success, could you be the newest member of our team?
**Analog Layout Engineer – 5nm and Below experience**
Agile Analog is revolutionising the way Analog circuits are designed. We are developing a process-agnostic design methodology that uses automation to accelerate the generation of circuits and IP for our customers. Using our innovative technology, we have the capability to design circuits faster, to a higher quality and on any silicon process.
Based in Cambridge with a fantastic new managed office, we are also one of the few companies continuing to embrace the flexibility of hybrid and remote working. Should you not be local to Cambridge, or remote working appeals, feel free to apply. Please note that we are currently only accepting applications from candidates who already have the right to work in the UK.
We are disrupting methodologies that have remained largely unchanged for generations. If you think differently, enjoy working across multiple projects and want to use your knowledge to help develop new ideas and methodologies, we would love to hear from you.
What you will be doing
* Developing and implementing analog and mixed-signal IC layouts for TSMC 4nm FinFET technology and 5nm and below.
* Working with high performance advanced-node PDKs and technology-specific layout requirements is also essential
* Creating and modifying analog layout at cell and macro level, with an emphasis on clean, robust and manufacturable layouts.
* Applying fundamental analog layout techniques including matching, symmetry, common-centroid structures, shielding and appropriate device placement and routing.
* Running and interpreting physical verification checks, including LVS and DRC, and supporting the resolution of layout issues.
* Working closely with circuit designers to understand layout requirements and translate circuit schematics into physical implementation.
* Supporting DFM and layout optimisation activities for TSMC 4nm.
* Contributing to improvements and automation of the analog layout process.
* Working efficiently and collaboratively across multiple projects to deliver high-quality IP.

* Experience working with TSMC PDKs, technology files and design-rule requirements.
* Familiarity with physical verification, including LVS and DRC, and the ability to investigate and resolve layout issues.
* A good understanding of analog layout fundamentals, including device placement, matching, symmetry and routing.

* Software development or strong scripting skills.

The Quality Product Analysis Specialist plays a critical role within the Technical & Quality Centre by conducting in-depth inspections, diagnostic testing, and root cause analysis of returned automotive components.
This position ensures that warranty claims are assessed accurately and consistently while supporting overall product quality, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Working across a broad range of systems—including turbochargers, braking components, suspension units, clutches, and rotating electrics (alternators and starters)—the specialist applies advanced mechanical and electrical expertise to determine failure causes, verify product performance against factory specifications, and differentiate between manufacturing defects and usage-related issues.
The role combines hands-on technical evaluation with detailed digital reporting and cross-functional collaboration. Using specialized testing equipment and precision measuring tools, the specialist generates comprehensive inspection reports, documents findings with photographic evidence, and supports warranty decision-making in alignment with company policies and regulatory standards.
Beyond technical capability, the position requires strong analytical thinking and a methodical, investigative mindset. The Quality Product Analysis Specialist acts as a key liaison between warranty administration, customer service, and manufacturing partners—clearly communicating technical findings to ensure timely and fair claim resolution.
This role is essential in safeguarding product integrity, improving quality performance, and maintaining customer confidence through accurate, data-driven analysis and professional technical expertise.
**Core Responsibilities**
• Component Inspection: Conduct detailed physical and functional inspections on a wide range of components including turbos, braking systems, suspension units, clutches, and rotating electrics (alternators/starters).
• Diagnostic Testing: Operate specialised test equipment (e.g., vacuum testers, electronic actuator testers, battery/alternator analysers, brake DTV machines, and brake caliper testers) to verify part performance against factory specifications.
• Root Cause Analysis: Investigate and determine the underlying cause of failure (e.g., carbon buildup, oil starvation, electrical surges, installation errors) to support warranty claim evaluations.
• Warranty Claim Assessment: Review and assess warranty claims in accordance with company policies, determining validity and identifying potential manufacturing or usage defects.
• Digital Reporting & Documentation: Utilise computer systems to log findings, upload digital photos of defects, generate professional inspection and warranty evaluation reports, and maintain accurate records for claim processing.
• Quality & Compliance: Maintain a clean, organised laboratory/testing environment ensuring all test equipment is in safe and calibrated working order. Ensure inspections comply with company standards and relevant regulatory requirements.
• Cross-Functional Communication: Collaborate closely with warranty administration, customer service, and re manufacturing teams to share findings, explain technical details, and support timely claim resolution.
**Technical Skills & Knowledge (Hard Skills)**
• Multi-System Mastery: Deep mechanical knowledge of modern vehicle and electronic systems.
• Electrical Proficiency: Ability to read electrical schematics and use multimetres or oscilloscopes to test rotating electrics and electronic sensors.
• Software Literacy: Comfortable with PC-based diagnostic software, CRM portals, warranty management systems, and standard office tools (e.g., Microsoft Word/Excel).
• Precision Measurement: Skilled with precision tools such as micrometres, vernier calipers, and dial indicators for checking tolerances and shaft play.
• Warranty & Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of warranty policies, claim processing procedures, and applicable regulatory standards.
**Character Qualities & Professionalism (Soft Skills)**
• Analytical Thinking: Logical, detective-like mindset adept at solving complex diagnostic puzzles that other technicians may overlook.
• Attention to Detail: Precision in inspecting fracture surfaces, wear patterns, and minute electrical deviations.
• Reliability & Punctuality: Strict adherence to schedules and deadlines, ensuring customer and warranty reports are delivered on time.
• Clear Communication: Ability to translate complex technical failures into clear, simple language for non-technical stakeholders, customers, and internal teams.
• Collaboration: Effective team player with proven ability to coordinate across departments for efficient warranty handling.
**Desired Qualifications & Experience**
• Proven Experience: Ideally 3–5 years as a senior technician or diagnostic specialist in a high-volume garage, remanufacturing environment, or warranty inspection role.
• Certification: Level 3 Automotive Technician qualification or equivalent (e.g., IMI or City & Guilds).
• Failure Analysis Training. Warranty Training: Experience or formal training related to warranty claim evaluation and processing preferred.
**Physical Requirements**
• Capacity to safely handle heavy components (e.g., alternators, brake discs) and stand for extended periods in a workshop or laboratory environment.

# Exhibition Stand Project Manager
**Location:** East London – Head Office **Job Type:** Full-time, Permanent **Hours:** 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday + regular overtime **Salary:** Competitive, dependent on experience **Start:** ASAP / Quick start preferred **Benefits:** On-site parking
Apply
## About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Exhibition Stand Project Manager to join our growing team at our East London headquarters.
We design, produce and deliver modular exhibition stands across the UK, with a strong focus on integrating technology such as LED walls, display screens, touchscreens and other AV solutions into our stands.
This is a varied, hands-on position covering the full lifecycle of an exhibition project. You will work across design, estimating, sales, technical planning and project management, taking projects from the initial client brief through to successful installation on site.
This is not purely a desk-based project management role. We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of how exhibition stands actually go together, who can develop practical solutions, communicate confidently with clients and take ownership of projects from start to finish.
## Key Responsibilities
* Manage exhibition stand projects from initial enquiry through to completion
* Interpret client briefs and develop creative, practical and commercially viable solutions
* Produce and develop exhibition stand designs using **SketchUp**
* Prepare quotations, estimates and project specifications
* Design and plan stands using **Aluvision, beMatrix or similar modular framing systems**
* Specify stand components, graphics, furniture, lighting and AV requirements
* Plan and manage **SEG fabric graphics and other exhibition print**
* Integrate LED walls, TVs, touchscreens and other AV equipment into stand designs
* Produce accurate equipment, stock and material requirements
* Use **Current RMS or similar hire/stock/project management software**
* Liaise directly with clients throughout the design and delivery process
* Coordinate suppliers, production teams, warehouse staff and installation crews
* Manage project budgets, schedules and deadlines
* Prepare clear technical and production information for build teams
* Identify and resolve technical, logistical and design issues
* Manage multiple live exhibition projects simultaneously
* Support exhibition installations and site activity when required
* Ensure projects are delivered safely, accurately, on time and to a high standard
## What We're Looking For
**Previous professional experience within the exhibition stand industry is essential.**
You should have strong experience in several of the following areas:
* Modular exhibition systems, particularly **Aluvision and/or beMatrix**
* **SketchUp** or comparable 3D design software
* Exhibition stand project management
* Exhibition stand estimating and costing
* SEG graphics and exhibition print
* AV and display technology
* Hire, stock or project management software such as **Current RMS**
* Production and installation planning
* Client and supplier management
You will also need:
* Excellent organisational and project management skills
* Strong technical and practical understanding
* Good commercial awareness
* Excellent attention to detail
* Confident written and verbal communication
* The ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-moving environment
* A proactive approach to problem-solving
* The ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
* A good understanding of how exhibition stands are manufactured, prepared and installed
* **The right to work in the UK**
## Desirable Experience
Experience in any of the following would be an advantage, but is not essential:
* Exhibition stand sales and business development
* Adobe Creative Suite
* AutoCAD or other CAD/design software
* RAMS and venue documentation
* Electrical and lighting specifications
* Logistics and transport planning
* UK exhibition venues and organiser requirements
* Hands-on modular stand building or installation experience
## Why Join Us?
We are a fast-growing exhibition company with a strong focus on combining modular exhibition systems with modern technology.
Rather than simply supplying conventional exhibition stands, we increasingly incorporate LED walls, digital displays, touchscreens and interactive technology to create modern and engaging exhibition environments.
This role offers the opportunity to be involved in the entire process. You won't simply be handed a project to administer – you'll have input into the design, technical solution, costing, client relationship and final delivery.
For someone with the right exhibition industry experience, there is significant opportunity to take ownership, develop within the business and play an important role as the exhibitions department continues to grow.
## Working Hours
This is a full-time, permanent, office-based position at our East London headquarters, working 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.
Due to the nature of the exhibition industry, regular overtime and occasional evening, weekend or site work will be required, particularly around installations and busy periods.
On-site parking is available.
## How to Apply
Please apply with your CV, salary expectations and earliest available start date - seb@ambien.co.uk
Where possible, we would also like to see examples of exhibition stands or projects you have previously designed, managed or delivered.
Please note: Previous exhibition stand industry experience is essential for this position.

## About The Role
We are looking for an experienced & enthusiastic Maya TD to be a front-line technical support point for our animation and lighting artists. Day to day, you'll be the person that artists come to when Maya, or the pipeline tools around it, isn't behaving. You'll diagnose and resolve problems across animation and lighting, and get people unblocked quickly through our support ticket queue. To do that well you'll get to know our publishing workflows, which you'll be able to pick up on the job.
This is a hands-on problem-solving role. Your priority is triaging incoming tickets, reproducing and diagnosing Maya issues, and guiding artists to a fix with patience and clarity. You'll draw on a deep, practical knowledge of Maya to work out why something's broken and the quickest way to get the artist moving again. Success in this role is measured by artists feeling well looked after and getting back to creating quickly
The successful candidate will need excellent problem-solving skills combined with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical artists, demonstrating patience and confidence under pressure.
You'll be part of our technical team, working closely with production and with the animation and lighting department leads. Most of your day will be spent supporting artists on our TV series and broadcast animation projects.
**We are very happy to discuss flexible, hybrid and remote working options for all our vacancies.**
**Please note that this vacancy can close early if we receive a high number of applications.**
**The successful candidate will need to be based in the UK and will require the right to work in the UK.**
**Day to Day:**
* Act as the first point of contact for artist support tickets, triaging and prioritising the queue so the most urgent, production-critical issues are handled first.
* Diagnose and resolve a wide range of Maya animation and lighting issues, along with problems in the related Maya pipeline tools artists use every day: reproduce the problem, find the root cause, and get the artist to a resolution.
* Get hands-on inside artists' scenes to troubleshoot everything from scene setup, references and rigs through to lighting, publishing and render problems.
* Communicate clearly and kindly with animation and lighting artists, translating technical detail into plain language and keeping people updated on progress.
* Escalate complex or systemic issues to the wider technical team with clear, reproducible write-ups.
* Spot recurring problems and share quick fixes, tips or short guides so the same issue doesn't keep coming back.
* Be online and available to artists during core studio hours, keeping the queue covered through the working day.
* Keep support documentation and FAQs up to date so common issues can be self-served by artists.
* React and respond quickly to production needs and handle a busy, high-pressure ticket queue.
* Juggle multiple tickets and projects at once and logically prioritise tasks.
* Constantly learn on the job, staying up to date with new tools and techniques across the studio's toolset.
## About You
**Must Have:**
* Deep, proven production experience with Maya and the pipeline tools that sit around it.
* Demonstrable Maya problem-solving, with real examples of diagnosing and resolving animation and lighting issues in production that you can talk through at interview.
* Familiarity with how a Maya-based animation pipeline fits together (references, asset hand-offs between departments, scene structure and render setup), enough to know where a problem sits and when to escalate. You'll pick up our own publishing workflows on the job.
* Experience working with & using Redshift
* Ability to reproduce an issue, work out the root cause, and find the fastest route to a fix

* Strong Production experience in a Maya-based animation studio (using Redshift).

* Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
* Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
* Calm and organised under pressure, able to prioritise a busy queue without dropping the ball.
* A fast, pro-active learner able to work autonomously as well as collaboratively within the team
* A good understanding of a production pipeline and how work flows between departments.
* Genuinely enjoys helping people and takes pride in unblocking artists quickly.

# Finance Systems Analyst
London, England, United Kingdom
## Opportunity
The Finance Systems team at Brunswick is looking for a Finance Systems Analyst to join the team on a 12-month fixed-term contract.
This is a varied and collaborative role at the heart of Brunswick’s business operations, supporting our core ERP platform and the colleagues who rely on it every day. You’ll combine hands-on technical support and problem-solving with opportunities to improve systems, deliver enhancements and work with stakeholders across the firm.
It’s a great opportunity to join a global, high-performing business where you’ll gain broad exposure, build strong relationships and make a tangible contribution to how we work.
## About the Role
As a Finance Systems Analyst, you’ll be a key member of the application support team, providing first-line support to colleagues and taking initial responsibility for triaging, investigating and resolving support requests.
Alongside day-to-day application support, you’ll contribute to the continued development of our application landscape. This includes helping colleagues get the most from our systems, supporting user acceptance testing (UAT), and contributing to system enhancements and strategic application changes.
The Finance Systems team is managed by the Finance Systems Manager and sits within our Global Finance function.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Application Support
* Providing 1st and 2nd tier support, including logging, managing and maintaining accurate records of colleague queries through HALO
* Investigating and troubleshooting system and software issues, diagnosing problems and identifying effective solutions
* Planning and carrying out scheduled system maintenance and other routine activities
* Managing user accounts and supporting the security model
* Maintaining master data, including project resources for timecards and expenses, and delegate access for partners and senior colleagues
* Working closely with partners and colleagues across the firm to support the smooth operation of our core ERP platform
Training & Testing
* Supporting user acceptance testing for system upgrades and developments
* Helping colleagues build their knowledge and confidence through end-user training
* Creating practical support materials, including task recordings, quick-reference guides and other user resources
Systems Development & Projects
* Supporting the delivery of strategic system enhancements
* Identifying and promoting opportunities to improve systems and ways of working
* Testing enhancements and helping ensure changes are successfully implemented
## What We’re Looking For
We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, helping people and learning how systems work. You’ll be comfortable balancing technical detail with a strong service mindset and building effective relationships with colleagues at different levels of the organisation. Ideally, you’ll bring:
* Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 or a similar ERP platform
* Experience in a finance systems, IT support or related role
* A strong customer service ethos and a collaborative approach
* Good analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Clear and confident communication skills
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
* A logical and methodical approach to your work
* Enthusiasm for learning and developing your skills
## Why Join Us
Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.
# About Brunswick
Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes.
Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.
Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. * Explore and implement Agentic AI opportunities across areas such as content creation, lead nurturing, campaign testing, insights and reporting.
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Data & Insight and Global Key Accounts teams to improve segmentation, personalisation, attribution and campaign performance.
* Establish strong platform governance, processes and best practices while ensuring appropriate compliance and human oversight of AI.
* Manage the roadmap and backlog for marketing platform enhancements, technical support and stakeholder requests.
* Support global adoption through effective change management, training and user enablement.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardise marketing processes across a complex global organisation.

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot/Lightning) and Salesforce.
* Experience using or implementing AI within marketing, with an interest in emerging Agentic AI capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of multi-channel campaigns, segmentation, personalisation, campaign measurement and Account-Based Marketing (ABM).
* Experience with CMS platforms such as Optimizely/EPiServer and workflow tools such as Workfront would be advantageous.
* Proven experience leading projects and managing stakeholders across technical and marketing teams.
* Experience working within a global, highly matrixed organisation.
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into practical marketing solutions.
* Experience supporting change, process improvement, training and adoption of new systems or ways of working.
* A collaborative, solutions-focused approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results.
## What we offer

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of BSI’s marketing technology landscape, working with global stakeholders and emerging AI capabilities to make marketing more connected, intelligent and effective.

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 27-days annual leave, paid sick leave, bank holidays, health insurance, life insurance, pension plan with company contribution, income protection, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, paid parental leave, adoption leave, compassionate leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Join BSI as a **Standards Engagement Manager** and help shape standards that protect people, improve products and services, and support trusted practices across a range of industries.
This is not a technical, regulatory, or auditing role, and previous standards experience is not required. Instead, we're looking for a strong communicator with stakeholder engagement, project management, and facilitation skills who can manage a diverse portfolio of standards committees and projects.
**About the role:**
In this role, you'll work as part of a team supporting a range of national committees spanning manufacturing, healthcare, mobility, the built environment etc. You'll work with industry experts, government representatives, consumer groups, professional bodies and other stakeholders to develop standards that address current and emerging challenges.
As part of BSI's role as the UK's National Standards Body, you'll facilitate discussions, build consensus, oversee standards development projects, engage with external stakeholders and help identify opportunities for new standards that deliver positive outcomes for society. This is a unique opportunity to support the creation of best practice, support innovation and contribute to work that has national and international impact.
This is an exciting role for someone who enjoys working across a varied range of responsibilities and tasks, building strong professional networks, and delivering projects against guidelines which make a tangible difference.
**Responsibilities:**
* Contribute to managing a portfolio of national committees, ensuring they operate effectively, remain representative of stakeholder interests, and contribute to standards development.
* Provide governance oversight and procedural support to committees, chairs and members in accordance with BSI policies and standards development processes.
* Facilitate committee meetings and standards development activities, supporting stakeholders to achieve consensus and deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Build and maintain relationships with industry experts, trade associations, government bodies, consumer representatives and other key stakeholders.
* Monitor committee performance and participation, identifying risks, issues and opportunities to improve effectiveness and stakeholder engagement.
* Recruit, onboard and support committee members and chairs, ensuring committees are diverse, maintain balanced representation and appropriate expertise.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of committee records, actions and governance documentation within designated systems and processes.
* As part of a team, deliver standards projects to agreed timescales, working closely with internal colleagues across Content, Marketing, Policy and other teams.
* Become an expert in standards development procedures to provide advice and support to committee chairs, experts and stakeholders throughout the standards development process.
* Work collaboratively across BSI teams to deliver an efficient, customer-focused service and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
**What we're looking for:**
We're open to exploring all professional backgrounds however, experience in volunteer membership management, or sector knowledge can be beneficial. We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate the following:
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with confidence in leading discussions and engaging diverse stakeholder groups.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships, influence others and manage differing viewpoints constructively.
* Experience of stakeholder engagement, partnership working or committee management.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* A proven ability to work as part of a team, taking responsibility and driving activities forward proactively.
* An awareness of project management, including planning, prioritising and managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn about new industries, technologies and societal challenges.
* The ability to analyse information, identify opportunities and translate insights into action.
* Adaptability to change and learning new processes or ways of working.
**Other useful information:**
This position is based on a hybrid working model, with attendance at our Covent Garden office required twice per month. We welcome applications from candidates based outside London, provided you are able to travel to the office as needed for committee meetings and other business requirements.

This role exists because we believe Design should play an even bigger role in shaping the products we build and the decisions we make.
We're looking for someone with exceptional product design judgement and taste. Someone who can raise the quality bar through coaching, thoughtful critique and selective hands-on contribution. BytePlus is bringing ByteDance's advanced foundation model capabilities to enterprise customers worldwide. * HubSpot data quality: completeness and currency of accounts, contacts, whitespace cells and opportunities.
****KEY RELATIONSHIPS**** ****Internal**** * ****VP of Growth**** — line manager, targets and forecast.

# Senior DevOps Engineer
London, UK
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to **Unleash the Potential** of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.
We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.
Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.
### **WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT PLATFORM ENGINEERING**
We are looking for a talented and inquisitive Senior DevOps Engineer whose drive for learning and determination for continuous improvement aligns with our ambitious, fast-growing and transforming company. Based in our London office, you will be a key player in planning, designing, building and testing the features of our next-generation cloud platform that combines digital video assets, wearable data and athlete information to provide insights and analytics to coaching/support staff, sports scientists and athletes to assist in optimizing athlete performance. We believe that our customers deserve the best platform and we are on a mission to maximize and enhance their performance through delivering a high-quality experience. Our software and DevOps engineers match this ethos by taking responsibility for constantly improving productivity and development of self and be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.
### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**
* Cloud & Platform Engineering
+ Infrastructure Automation & IaC: Own infrastructure provisioning and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
+ Observability & Reliability: Design, build and maintain logging, monitoring, alerting, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure system health and performance.
+ Software Delivery Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, safe, and repeatable software delivery.
+ Infrastructure Operations & Governance: Oversee the availability, scalability, and performance of cloud and on-prem infrastructure while ensuring all systems remain strictly aligned with corporate security standards and global regulatory compliance.
* Cloud Security
+ Cloud Security & Compliance: Ensure compliance with relevant compliance and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR as applicable) and implement best practices cloud security controls.
+ Security Operation: Lead security first approach, collaborate with Security and IT teams to make sure our infrastructure is patched according to SLAs.
+ Application Security (AppSec): Collaborate with security teams to embed security controls into CI/CD pipelines and platform services.
* Technology leader
+ Architectural Roadmap & Vision: Define and execute the long-term technical roadmap for Catapult’s global cloud platform, evaluating emerging technologies (e.g., Serverless, AI-driven operations, and Containerization) to ensure the infrastructure remains cutting-edge, scalable, and best to used by our customers.
+ Technical Governance & Standards: Be a big contribution to infrastructure decisions, establishing "Golden Paths" and reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns that dictate how engineering teams deploy services while ensuring consistency across all environments.
+ Strategic Security & Compliance Integration: Architect and champion a "Shift-Left" security strategy, mandating the integration of automated security guardrails and compliance auditing into the core fabric of the CI/CD pipelines to protect athlete and video data globally.
### **WHAT YOU’LL NEED**
* Significant experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, Platform or Infrastructure Engineering, with tenure in technical leadership role.
* Deep expertise in the AWS cloud platform and associated security and compliance practices.
* Strong background in infrastructure automation (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.
* Proven experience with big platform re-design, architecture of new cloud infrastructure systems based on software and business requirements.
* Solid understanding of AppSec principles, including integrating security into build and deploy pipelines.
* Experience managing hybrid environments, including traditional data centers and on-prem services.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence across engineering, security, and finance.
* Experience with regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, fintech).
* Familiarity with multiple compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).
### **WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE**
In 6 months time...
By the half-year mark, you will have moved beyond the onboarding phase to become the primary authority on Catapult’s infrastructure.
* Infrastructure Ownership: You will fully own the cloud infrastructure, having gained a deep understanding of all interconnected parts that support their athlete and video data services.
* Established Automation: You will have taken control of infrastructure provisioning and configuration management, ensuring that Terraform or Ansible are being used effectively for IaC.
* Observability Implementation: You will have designed and begun maintaining essential logging, monitoring, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure high system health and performance.
* Have a full understanding of Catapult’s products and the way we are working in order to be able to architect any new future existing or new product.
In 12 months time...
By the end of your first year, you will be driving the "next generation" of Catapult’s technology stack and leading cross-functional improvements.
* End to End Platform Ownership: You will take full accountability for the evolution of our production ecosystem, architecting a resilient, "deploy-anywhere" infrastructure that scales seamlessly with software demands and business growth.
* Optimized Delivery: You will have refined the CI/CD pipelines to a state where software delivery is consistently fast, safe, and repeatable across the engineering team.
* Integrated Security and Compliance: You will have transitioned the platform to a "security-first" architecture, successfully embedding automated AppSec controls and vulnerability scanning directly into the CI/CD pipelines.
* Cross-Departmental Influence: Your success will be reflected in your ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, security, and finance to drive technical and operational improvements.
**WHY CATAPULT?**
* We have amazing people. We promise you’ll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
* We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.
* We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
* Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.
* We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.
Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!
Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

# Manager, Salesforce Administration
* Full-time
## Company Description
**Who We Are**
Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.
We are feeding the world’s curiosity!
## Job Description
**We are looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Administrator to lead the day-to-day stewardship and continued evolution of our Salesforce ecosystem. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will guide and develop a team, own critical platform controls, and remain directly involved in the design, configuration, release and support of business-critical solutions.**
**The role is accountable for the reliability, security, scalability and maintainability of our Salesforce estate, with particular focus on Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and the APIs and integrations that connect Salesforce to Slack and other enterprise platforms. You will balance rapid delivery with strong governance, helping the organisation get more value from Salesforce without increasing operational or security risk.**
**What you will be accountable for**
**1. Team leadership and operating model**
* Lead and develop the Salesforce team, setting clear priorities, standards and expectations while creating an environment of ownership, learning and constructive challenge.
* Act as the senior escalation point, providing calm, evidence-led direction during incidents, complex delivery decisions and stakeholder conflicts.
* Shape the team operating model, including capacity planning, work allocation, skills development, recruitment support and the effective use of specialist partners.
* Build sustainable capability, through coaching, documentation, peer review and reducing dependency on individual team members or external suppliers.
**2. Salesforce platform ownership**
* Own the health and evolution of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, ensuring the platform supports commercial, customer-service and operational processes effectively.
* Set and enforce platform standards, covering configuration, automation, data models, naming conventions, documentation, testing and technical debt.
* Remain hands-on where needed, including complex Flow automation, permissions, validation rules, objects, page layouts, Lightning pages, reports, dashboards, analytics and troubleshooting.
* Own day-to-day system administration, including user administration, joiner/mover/leaver processing, delegated administration and routine platform hygiene.
* Configure and maintain Experience Cloud portals, including external sharing rules, guest user access, community settings, and partner- or customer-facing experiences.
* Maintain a clear platform roadmap that balances strategic improvements, regulatory or security obligations, operational resilience, and business demand.
* Control platform lifecycle changes, including Salesforce seasonal releases, feature adoption, deprecations, sandbox strategy and environment management.
* Evaluate and deploy AppExchange packages, assessing them against business requirements, security review status, licence cost, support model and long-term maintainability.
**3. Integrations, APIs and operational monitoring**
* Own the operational oversight of Salesforce integrations, including interfaces with Slack and other core enterprise applications.
* Administer and maintain key business integrations.
* Establish effective Slack API monitoring to cover authentication failures, token or certificate expirations, API errors, rate limits, latency, message delivery failures, and unexpected usage patterns.
* Define monitoring and alerting standards, with meaningful thresholds, named owners, support runbooks, escalation paths and service-level expectations.
* Protect integration reliability by overseeing connected apps, OAuth scopes, named credentials, integration users, event-driven services and API consumption.
* Lead incident response and problem management, ensuring root causes are understood, corrective actions are completed and recurring failures are designed out.
**4. Security, access and control posture**
* Own the Salesforce security posture, working with Security, IT and Risk teams to maintain proportionate, auditable controls.
* Design and maintain the org-wide sharing and security architecture, including organisation-wide defaults (OWD), role hierarchy, sharing rules, permission sets and permission-set groups, and field-level security.
* Apply least-privilege access, with appropriate segregation of duties and regular remediation of accumulated or excessive entitlements.
* Govern identities and privileged access, including SSO and MFA (working knowledge of Okta or a comparable identity provider), service accounts, integration users, delegated administration and joiner/mover/leaver controls.
* Lead regular security audits and access reviews to evidence least-privilege compliance and drive timely remediation of findings.
* Partner with IT and Security on platform audits and compliance, including SOC 2 and GDPR obligations, control evidence and audit response.
* Review platform risk signals, such as login anomalies, API usage, configuration changes, installed packages and connected-app behaviour, using the monitoring capabilities available in the Salesforce estate.
* Protect sensitive information through sound data-access design, retention controls, masking or anonymisation in non-production environments, and responsible vendor access.
**5. Licensing, certificates and lifecycle management**
* Optimise licence usage and forecasting across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, including reharvesting, right-sizing and renewal input.
* Monitor and manage certificate lifecycles, including SSL and SAML signing certificates, to prevent avoidable authentication or integration outages.
* Manage connected app and OAuth lifecycles, with a maintained inventory, named owners, expiry tracking and proactive renewal ahead of failure.
* Provide clear cost and entitlement visibility, so licence, package and integration spend is understood, challenged and aligned to realised value.
**6. Delivery, release and DevOps**
* Own a transparent and prioritised delivery backlog, working with business stakeholders to clarify outcomes, value, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain disciplined release management, with source control, peer review, automated or repeatable deployment, regression testing, rollback planning and release communications.
* Execute version-controlled releases through GitHub, using branch strategy, pull requests, peer approval and traceable change history as the standard route to production.
* Maintain documentation for all configuration and change management, so the estate remains understandable, auditable and supportable by more than one person.
* Improve platform support, using clear service measures, triage processes, knowledge articles, problem records and trend analysis.
* Manage technical debt deliberately, making risks and trade-offs visible and ensuring remediation is planned alongside new demand.
* Partner effectively with vendors, holding delivery partners to clear outcomes, quality standards, documentation and knowledge-transfer commitments.
**7. Data quality and platform insight**
* Champion trustworthy Salesforce data, including ownership, validation, duplicate management, integration reconciliation and remediation of recurring data-quality issues.
* Provide actionable platform insight, using dashboards and regular reporting on adoption, automation failures, API consumption, incidents, release quality, access risk and technical debt.
* Support sound architecture decisions, challenging unnecessary customisation and promoting maintainable, scalable use of standard Salesforce capabilities and enterprise-level data modelling.
**8. AI, Agentforce and emerging capabilities**
* Help evaluate and safely adopt Agentforce, Salesforce AI capabilities and adjacent enterprise AI tools where they can improve employee or customer outcomes.
* Support responsible AI governance, including data access, grounding, human oversight, prompt and agent testing, monitoring, auditability and change control.
* Contribute practical experience with Claude or comparable models, especially where AI services interact with Salesforce, Slack, knowledge content, workflows or customer data.
* Separate experimentation from production readiness, ensuring AI-enabled solutions meet the same security, reliability and support standards as other business-critical capabilities.
**Leadership behaviours**
* Service-minded ownership: you treat Salesforce as a critical business service, not simply a collection of projects.
* Wise pragmatism: you balance speed, usability, maintainability, cost and risk rather than optimising for only one dimension.
* Constructive challenge: you can say no, or not yet, with clear evidence and a practical route forward.
* Calm accountability: you take ownership when problems arise without creating blame or hiding uncomfortable facts.
* Enabling leadership: you give people clarity and support while building their confidence, judgement and independence.
* Clear communication: you make technical issues understandable and keep stakeholders informed before uncertainty becomes surprise.
**Key working relationships**
**The role will work closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Customer Service, Finance, Security, Enterprise Architecture, IT Operations, Data and Integration teams, as well as Salesforce and specialist implementation partners.**
## Qualifications
**Essential**
* 7+ years as a Salesforce Administrator in large, multi-team environments, with substantial hands-on responsibility for administration, configuration and operational support in a complex production environment.
* Salesforce Administrator certification (required).
* Proven people leadership, including line management, coaching, performance support, work prioritisation and development of Salesforce administrators or platform specialists.
* Deep practical knowledge of Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, including their security, automation, data and service-management implications.
* Deep Salesforce security expertise, covering organisation-wide defaults, role hierarchies, sharing models, permission sets, field-level security, identity, privileged access, connected apps and audit controls.
* Hands-on Experience Cloud capability, including external sharing models, guest access and community configuration.
* Proven Salesforce DevOps and change-management experience using GitHub, including version-controlled deployment workflows, pull-request review and release governance.
* Experience operating API-led integrations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, authentication, limits, failure handling and coordination across technical teams.
* Experience managing SSL and authentication certificates and maintaining integration health.
* Strong declarative delivery capability, particularly Flow, data modelling, validation, Lightning configuration, reporting and environment management.
* Sound release and change-management experience, including sandbox strategy, source control, testing, deployment governance and production support.
* Confident stakeholder management, with the ability to translate between commercial priorities, user needs, technical constraints and risk.
* Strong solution and design judgement, with a good understanding of platform architecture and enterprise-level data modelling.
**Desirable**
* Salesforce Advanced Administrator certification (preferred), or other relevant credentials such as Platform App Builder, Service Cloud Consultant or an appropriate Agentforce/AI accreditation.
* Experience administering Ironclad, Qualtrics and Slack CRM / Sales Elevate, or directly comparable CLM, survey and Slack-CRM tooling.
* Agentforce or Salesforce AI experience, including agent design, grounding, guardrails, evaluation or operational monitoring.
* Experience with Claude or other enterprise AI platforms, particularly in governed, data-sensitive business workflows.
* Experience with Slack platform capabilities and APIs, including enterprise integrations, apps, workflows, authentication and observability.
* Working knowledge of Okta or a comparable enterprise identity provider.
* Exposure to complementary enterprise platforms, such as NetSuite, MuleSoft, Celigo, Boomi, Workato, Zapier, identity providers or data platforms.
* Experience in a SaaS, technology or high-growth environment, where Salesforce supports complex B2B go-to-market and customer-service processes

# Strategic Growth Lead
**TL;DR: We're seeking a creative, self-starting SDR, BDR, or ISR ready for their next step — someone who wants to go beyond the sequence and the dialler and help Cloudsmith break into the largest companies on the planet. You'll join Cloudsmith's brand-new Global Strategic Accounts pod, reporting directly to its lead, and own outbound, campaigns, and events for a hand-picked list of Global 2000 target companies.**
## **About Cloudsmith**
Cloudsmith is the world’s most powerful artifact management platform. Software organizations of all sizes rely on Cloudsmith to control and secure their software supply chains. Cloudsmith allows customers to manage curated private repositories that proxy public open-source software registries. Developers use these repositories as their trusted source for build artifacts. We support over 30 formats, including the most popular languages, package managers, operating systems, and AI and container protocols.
We’re aimed at the enterprise, with built-in comprehensive security and advanced features for policy enforcement, integrations, and observability. Customers consider Cloudsmith critical infrastructure, a central part of their software build chain.
Cloudsmith is built by developers, for developers. We treasure the developer experience. The Tao of Cloudsmith expresses the values we live by every day. This is a special company, and now is a great time to join us.
## **The Role**
Cloudsmith already beats JFrog and Sonatype head-to-head at Fortune 100 and Fortune 500 scale — this year's two largest deals in company history were both won against those incumbents at household-name enterprises. We're now building a small, dedicated pod whose sole focus is turning that into a repeatable motion across the Global 2000.
As our first hire into this pod, you'll report directly to the Head of Global Strategic Accounts and own the top of the funnel for a hand-picked list of the world's largest companies. This isn't a shared queue of inbound leads or a fixed daily-activity quota — it's a short list of accounts you'll build a real point of view on, and get creative to break into: sharp outbound, tailored campaigns built with Marketing, and small, high-intent in-person events. You'll pull in help from across Cloudsmith — Sales Engineering, Security, Product, Customer Success, even our executives — whenever a specific account calls for it.
This role suits a senior SDR or BDR ready to specialize rather than move straight into a closing seat, or an ISR who wants a defined path toward strategic/enterprise sales without skipping the step where you learn how the biggest companies in the world actually buy.
## **Key Responsibilities**
**Prospecting and Multi-Threading**
* Identify and research a defined list of named Global 2000 target accounts — no spray-and-pray sequences.
* Initiate and manage outbound communication through email, phone, and social media, built around each account's specific situation.
**Campaigns and ABM**
* Partner with Marketing to design 1:1 and 1:few campaigns for named accounts — bespoke landing pages, tailored content, and sequences built around that specific company.
* Bring an account-based, "treat-the-account-as-the-market" approach to Cloudsmith's Global 2000 target list.
**Events and In-Person Programs**
* Plan and run small, high-intent in-person programs — executive dinners, roundtables, regional meetups — aimed at Global 2000 buying committees.
* Own conference and trade-show follow-through: identify target-account attendees in advance, work the floor, and convert conversations into pipeline (this is exactly how Cloudsmith's second-largest deal ever got started).
**Creative, "Left-Field" Tactics**
* Pull in resources from other departments — Product, Security, Customer Success, executives — for single-account "surge" plays when a big swing calls for it.
* Test unconventional channels: direct mail, gifting, warm intros via investors, advisors, or customers, and open-source/developer-community engagement.
**Reporting and CRM Management**
* Qualify leads and hand off sales-ready opportunities to the pod lead and Strategic AEs with full context — buying committee, signals, competitive situation.
* Keep accurate records of prospect and account interactions in the CRM (HubSpot & Salesforce), and track what's working across outbound, campaigns, and events.

**Technical Expertise**
* Proven experience in an SDR, BDR, or ISR role — ideally selling or prospecting into complex technical buyers (software, cloud, DevOps, or security solutions).
* 2–4+ years of sales/prospecting experience, with some exposure to enterprise or named-account motions a strong plus.
* Proficiency working in a CRM, sales prospecting tools, and web-based conferencing systems (Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce.com, Intercom, and Zoom).
* Demonstrated success meeting pipeline/sales goals, with a solid track record.
* Familiarity with sales strategies like email sequences, cold calling, and social selling — plus a track record of going beyond them.
**Knowledge & Skills**
* **Tech-Savvy:** comfortable engaging with technical buyers and understanding DevOps, cloud, or CI/CD processes.
* **Curious and Coachable:** eager to learn, adapt to feedback, and grow within a fast-paced environment.
* **Creative & Resourceful:** comfortable owning marketing-adjacent work — campaign ideation, event planning — not just call and email volume.
* **Executive Presence:** genuinely comfortable engaging senior stakeholders (security leaders, VPs of Engineering, CTOs) at some of the largest companies in the world.
* **Excellent Communicator:** clear and professional in verbal and written communication.
### **Cultural Values We're Looking For**
* **Customer Focused:** Give customers a voice and make sure we listen. We want to create a buying experience that customers would pay for.
* **Collective Ownership:** Share responsibility and ownership. Help us all improve together, we are all accountable for the success of the company.
* **Honesty & Transparency:** Direct, honest communication with a focus on building & maintaining trust.
## **Benefits, Location & Work Environment**
Note: You must be based in Northern Ireland or ROI and have the right to work independently without requiring sponsorship.
### **Headlines**

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Generous annual leave and flexible working policies to suit your lifestyle.
* A professional development budget for conferences and training.
* A dynamic, innovative, trust-centric, and supportive work environment.
* The chance to help build a brand-new function from scratch, with direct visibility to Cloudsmith's leadership team.
* Regular travel for onsites with target accounts and industry events — this is very much a get-out-from-behind-the-desk role.

We're looking for someone who can balance creativity with commercial rigor — who has the account-based instincts to build a point of view on a Fortune-scale company before ever picking up the phone, and who's fearless about trying tactics nobody's tried at Cloudsmith before. We're critical infrastructure by developers / for developers, building the world's software supply chain platform — and now taking that story to the Global 2000. Job Description
Role Purpose
Crown Agents Bank connects emerging and frontier markets to the rest of the world, and that depends on software that can reliably integrate CAB's own systems with a wide range of third-party platforms, correspondent banks and internal data consumers. This role exists to design, build and evolve those integration solutions and the cloud-native platforms that support them – which, depending on where the team's priorities lie, may include the Operational Data Store (built on Debezium, Java, Spring Boot and Aurora Serverless v2) alongside other integration and platform work. The Associate Vice President works hands-on with a high degree of initiative and autonomy, contributing actively to design discussions alongside the Data and Integration Services Lead and Architecture colleagues, and taking responsibility for turning agreed designs into resilient, well-built software and infrastructure. Engineers are expected and encouraged to utilise the latest in AI tooling in their delivery and champion it’s use in our platforms. Role Responsibilities

Define and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines using Git and GitHub Actions, to support safe, repeatable deployment. Establish and monitor observability and data quality standards using Dynatrace and PowerBI, helping identify and resolve issues before they affect downstream consumers. Support and guide less experienced engineers and analysts on the team, reviewing code and designs and sharing knowledge that helps raise the bar on engineering practice. # **Meet DeepL**
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
## **What sets us apart**
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.
## **Meet the team behind this journey**
You will lead the Production Inference team — the group responsible for the systems that serve DeepL's language AI models reliably and efficiently at scale. We sit at the intersection of research-grade technical ambition and production-grade operational discipline: our work determines whether DeepL's models reach users with the latency, reliability, and cost profile that makes commercial deployment viable. The team owns the full model serving stack — from GPU-resident inference runtimes and deployment infrastructure through to the developer platform that enables every other research team to bring their models to production. We operate within the Research organisation, with close ties to DeepL's infrastructure and platform functions, and our architectural decisions affect every product DeepL ships. The broader Research organisation publishes regularly at ACL, NeurIPS, and EMNLP, and the Production Inference team brings that same culture of rigour and innovation to the systems layer of AI.
## **Your responsibilities**
As Engineering Manager for the Production Inference team, you will own both people leadership and technical direction for a team of research scientists and ML engineers working on performance-critical model serving systems. While this is not a hands-on coding role, you will be deeply involved in technical reviews, architecture decisions, and research direction for the inference stack.
You will:
* Lead and develop a high-performing team of research scientists and ML engineers, building strong development plans, fostering a candid and non-retaliatory feedback culture, and maintaining high standards of technical rigour and delivery.
* Own the team's research and development roadmap for production inference systems, in close collaboration with senior ICs and cross-functional stakeholders, balancing near-term reliability commitments with longer-horizon research bets on inference efficiency and architecture.
* Act as the primary technical interface between the Production Inference team and adjacent functions — including foundational models research, voice research, applied research, infrastructure, and product — ensuring research output is well-scoped, well-communicated, and delivered without creating downstream bottlenecks.
* Drive the reliability, efficiency, and cost performance of DeepL's model serving stack, including strategic decisions around serving infrastructure evolution (load balancing, autoscaling, runtime selection, and hardware utilisation).
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, defining the team's direction and pushing for results in an environment where requirements from product or commercial stakeholders can be ambiguous or evolving.
* Play an active role in identifying, assessing, and recruiting research and engineering talent as the team continues to develop.
## **Qualities we look for**
* You have proven experience leading a team of researchers or ML engineers, with a track record of developing talent, maintaining delivery rigour, and holding the balance between research quality and production reliability.
* You have a strong background Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a comparable quantitative discipline, or possess a strong ML/systems background with equivalent research depth.
* You have a strong foundation in production ML systems, inference optimisation, or model serving at scale — direct experience with LLM inference, speculative decoding, quantisation, or serving infrastructure is a meaningful differentiator.
* You are comfortable operating across the full model lifecycle — from training handoff through to production deployment, monitoring, and efficiency improvement — and understand infrastructure and compute constraints without needing to own them directly.
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical direction into clear goals for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* You are solution-oriented and decisive, able to define direction and drive outcomes without waiting for direction from above.
## **What we offer**
* **Diverse and internationally distributed team**: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
* **Open communication, regular feedback**: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
* **Hybrid work, flexible hours**: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
* **Virtual Shares -** An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
* **Regular in-person team events**: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
* **Monthly full-day hacking sessions**: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
* **30 days of annual leave**: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
* **Competitive benefits**: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

Denodo is looking for an ambitious and hands-on BDR/SDR Manager – EMEA to lead, coach and develop our Business Development/ Sales Development organization across key European markets. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced BDR/SDR Team Leader ready to step into their first management role, or an existing BDR/SDR Manager with up to approximately three years of management experience who is looking for broader international responsibility.
The successful candidate will lead a team responsible for creating qualified sales pipeline across the UK, France, DACH, the Nordics and Eastern Europe, working closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Sales Leadership and Revenue Operations. Lead & Develop the BDR/SDR Team

* Conduct call reviews, role plays and coaching sessions to improve individual performance.

* Develop BDR/SDRs as a key internal talent pool for future Account Executive and other sales roles.

Build & Improve Pipeline
* Own BDR/SDR pipeline generation across inbound, outbound and account-based sales development activities.
* Work closely with Account Executives to identify and prioritize target accounts.
* Develop effective outbound strategies for enterprise accounts and buying groups.
* Ensure the team is focused on creating quality opportunities and pipeline, not simply maximizing activity.
* Continuously improve prospecting approaches, messaging, sequences and qualification.
* Monitor conversion rates throughout the funnel and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure effective handoff and alignment between BDRs/SDRs and Account Executives.

* Analyze activity, conversion, pipeline and meeting data to identify trends, opportunities and risks.
* Turn data into clear coaching actions and measurable improvement plans.
* Establish and track appropriate BDR/SDR KPIs.
* Forecast BDR/SDR-generated pipeline accurately and proactively communicate risks and opportunities.
* Provide regular performance insight to Sales Leadership.
Partner Across Sales & Marketing
* Work closely with Account Executives to ensure BDR/SDR activity is aligned with territory and revenue priorities.
* Partner with Marketing on campaigns, events, content and demand-generation initiatives.
* Provide feedback to Marketing on campaign quality, messaging and prospect response.
* Work with Sales and Product Marketing to ensure BDR/SDR messaging clearly communicates Denodo's value proposition.
* Support account-based marketing and coordinated sales plays across strategic accounts.
* Share market feedback and competitive insights with the wider organization.
Continuously Improve
* + Develop and implement BDR/SDR best practices across prospecting, qualification and meeting generation.
+ Test and implement new approaches to outbound prospecting, messaging and engagement.
+ Improve processes, technology and workflows to increase productivity and effectiveness.
+ Help evolve the BDR/SDR operating model as Denodo continues to grow across Europe.
+ Bring new ideas, energy and a continuous-improvement mindset to the organization.

* A BDR/SDR Team Leader ready for your first Manager role
* A Senior BDR/SDR with demonstrable leadership or mentoring experience
* A BDR/SDR Manager with up to approximately three years of management experience
* A Business Development professional who has successfully stepped into people leadership
