* Proven experience in BDR, SDR, inside sales or business development.
* Experience in B2B technology, SaaS, enterprise software or a similarly complex sales environment.
* Experience coaching, mentoring or managing BDR/SDR professionals.
* A track record of achieving or exceeding sales development or pipeline targets.
* Strong understanding of outbound prospecting and enterprise account engagement.
* Experience working with Account Executives and sales teams to convert BDR/SDR activity into qualified pipeline.
* A data-driven approach to managing performance.
* Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM.
* Excellent communication, coaching and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence engaging with senior stakeholders and enterprise decision-makers.
* A hands-on approach — comfortable getting involved in the detail as well as setting direction.
* Resilience, curiosity and a genuine desire to continuously improve.
* The ability to operate effectively across different cultures and European markets.
Language Skills
* Fluent English is essential.
* Fluency in French or German would be highly advantageous given the geographical scope of the role.
* Additional European languages are also welcome.
**Desired Experience**
* Approximately 3–6 years' experience in BDR/SDR, inside sales, business development or sales development, including some leadership, coaching or people-management experience.
* Experience within enterprise software, SaaS, data, cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure or other B2B technology markets is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience building pipeline through outbound prospecting.
* Experience managing or supporting both inbound and outbound BDR/SDR motions.
* Experience with enterprise accounts and complex buying groups.
* Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM.
* Experience with sales engagement, prospecting, intent or data platforms is desirable.
* Strong understanding of sales development KPIs, funnel analytics and forecasting.
* Experience implementing structured coaching and performance-management practices.
* Bachelor's degree preferred, but equivalent professional experience will be considered.

##### Job Description
We are looking for an experienced and analytical Revenue & Financial Control Analyst to take ownership of the revenue and invoicing processes and other analytical work to support finance team.
This is a key role within the Finance function, created to provide greater visibility, accuracy and control across a high-volume customer billing environment.
The successful candidate will work closely with internal Finance and operational teams and the customer to ensure billing information is accurate, invoices are processed correctly and on time, and transactions can be clearly traced and reconciled across the relevant systems.
A key focus of the role will be developing a strong understanding of the systems and processes used by both our organisation and the customer to submit, process and reconcile invoices, ensuring that the end-to-end process is well controlled and transparent.
**Billing, Reconciliation & Financial Control**
* Take ownership of the customer's weekly invoicing and reconciliation process.
* Review billing data for completeness, accuracy and consistency.
* Reconcile operational data, billing systems, the general ledger, customer portals and customer statements.
* Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies, rejected invoices, short payments, credit notes and other exceptions.
* Ensure all billed revenue can be traced back to appropriate supporting documentation.
* Maintain a clear audit trail from source data through to invoice and payment.
* Identify potential revenue leakage, process errors and control weaknesses.
* Ensure billing adjustments and corrections are appropriately documented and approved.
* Monitor outstanding and disputed balances and work with the Accounts Receivable team to resolve issues.
* Maintain accurate records and supporting schedules for the customer account.
**Customer Billing Systems & Processes**
* Develop a detailed understanding of the systems and platforms used by both the company and customer throughout the billing process.
* Map and document the end-to-end billing process, including data inputs, approvals, invoice submission and reconciliation.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability across each stage of the process.
* Identify gaps in system visibility, documentation and controls.
* Maintain clear process documentation and standard operating procedures.
* Act as the Finance subject-matter expert for the customer's billing and invoicing process.
##### Qualifications
**Essential**
* ACCA qualified or actively studying towards ACCA – mandatory.
* Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business or a related subject.
* Experience in financial analysis, revenue, billing, accounts receivable or transactional finance.
* Strong Excel and data analysis skills, including reconciliations and working with large datasets.
* Experience with ERP, billing or financial systems.
* Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify discrepancies and find root causes.
* Good understanding of financial controls, accounting processes and reporting.
* Experience supporting audits and resolving financial issues.
* Strong communication, organisation and problem-solving skills.
**Desirable**
* CIMA qualified or studying towards CIMA.
* Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics/Navision, PAXIA or similar ERP systems.
* Experience in high-volume billing, revenue or customer finance.
* Experience improving financial processes and controls.
**Personal Attributes**
* Analytical – able to understand complex data and identify discrepancies.
* Detail-oriented – takes ownership of accuracy and financial control.
* Investigative – looks beyond the issue to understand its root cause.
* Proactive – anticipates problems and takes action before they escalate.
* Organised – able to manage recurring weekly processes alongside investigations.
* Confident – comfortable questioning data and processes when something doesn't look right.
* Systems-minded – interested in understanding how data moves between systems and how processes operate.
* Accountable – takes ownership and follows issues through to resolution.

**Scrum Master II Hybrid – Swindon or London Salary: £54,000 - £72,000 pa + Bonus**
From **The Scrum Guide 2020**:
“The Scrum Master is accountable for establishing Scrum as defined in the Scrum Guide. They do this by helping everyone understand Scrum theory and practice, both within the Scrum Team and the organisation.
The Scrum Master is accountable for the Scrum Team’s effectiveness. They do this by enabling the Scrum Team to improve its practices, within the Scrum framework.
Scrum Masters are true leaders who serve the Scrum Team and the larger organisation.”
**Source :** **https://scrumguides.org/docs/scrumguide/v2020/2020-Scrum-Guide-US.pdf** **(contains full description.)**
The Scrum Master II role is the continuation of an Agile career.
The Scrum Master role at Edenred PayTech closely follows the definition in the Scrum Guide. Additionally we ask our Scrum Masters to gain and practice skills from wider Agile disciplines such as **Kanban****,** **Disciplined Agile**, and **Better Value Sooner Safer Happier**, as we realise that one-Scrum-size does not fit all team contexts.
The Scrum Master does not govern nor manage the Product Backlog for the team. This is done jointly by the Product Manager/Product Owner, and the team (via pulling work into the Sprint Backlog each sprint). The Scrum Master facilitates, and encourages such backlog grooming and refinement.
Importantly a key aspect of the Scrum Master’s role is to champion early detection and removal / mitigation of cross-team dependencies. Such can create bottlenecks, ie: constraints that left unresolved will slow throughput of value to zero.
The Scrum Master II role typically covers two teams, and a person in this role demonstrates the **8 Stances of the Scrum Master****.** The Scrum Master as a:
Servant Leader Coach Facilitator Teacher Mentor Manager Impediment Remover Change Agent
**Accountable to**
* Scrum/Kanban Team
* Agile Lead
**Key Working Relationships**
* Agile Team
* Product Owner & Product Manager
* Business stakeholders
* Cross-collaboration with other teams via other Scrum Masters
**Key Responsibilities**
* Establishes Sprint Goals and enables team to focus upon, and achieve these. Ensures that Sprint Goals are aligned to quarterly team-level Programme Increments and associated value definitions.
* Embeds good Agile practices and associated Ways of Working (WoW) at team level, and influences the Engineering and Product departments via wider conversations, for example through our Agile Community of Practice.
* Discovers and commits Objectives and Key Results at the team level to measure success of WoW changes; uses metrics-as-feedback (eg: via LinearB) to establish a culture of evidence-based continuous improvement.
* Coaches and influences the Scrum Team towards improving WoW while taking into account, and balancing all aspects of Better Value Sooner Safer Happier.
* Proactively identifies, triages, unblocks, and escalates impediments impacting the Scrum Team. Establishes a culture of preventing impediments from occurring in preference to mitigating after-the-event.
**Skills & Behaviours**
**Role Specific**
* Championing Ways of Working (WoW) inside Scrum and/or Lean Agile (Kanban) teams, enabling the completion of Sprint Goals to deliver incremental customer value.
* You will be a self-learner who rapidly expands their knowledge of Agile practices, frameworks, and techniques. It is likely that you attend Agile meetups either inside or outside the company, and share ideas and learning with your peers.
* You will have a level 1 qualification in Agile such as PSM1, CSM, DASM, KMP, or ICP. Ideally you should be studying towards, or have achieved a level 2 / advanced qualification in Agile.
* Your background and experience is of paramount importance to help teams adopt an holistic view of software engineering. You may come from a computer science, pure science, business, military, or any other background. The key is being able to demonstrate knowledge of, and application of agility in practice & context with those whom you work with.
* You will have experience of working in an Agile iterative and/or incremental environment regularly solving problems and delivering value to customers. This does not need to be a software delivery environment, however the nature of our work means that knowledge of various Software Delivery Lifecycles is advantageous.
* You will practice the 8 stances of the Scrum Master, and will be able to shift your approach according to needs of the team.
* Significant experience of at least one, ideally two Agile frameworks and associated methods. Preference given to Scrum and Kanban.
* Able to communicate “why Agile” as well as “how to do Agile” to a varied audience including both those from software-technical and non-software-technical backgrounds.
* Experience of adopting Lean Principles (eg: focus on value, waste identification and elimination) with examples of successful changes to behaviour and practice yielding positive impact upon customer value delivered.
* Pragmatic / Agnostic Agile: selects methods and techniques best suited to context always in the context of people over process over tool.
* Evolving the team’s WoW to support the business’ North Star and associated key Values (https://www.edenred.com/en/candidates/our-values).
* Experience of scaling Agile WoW across at least two teams using appropriate elements of a core scaling framework such as Disciplined Agile, Nexus, LeSS and/or SAFe.
* Agile Planning focused on incremental delivery of internal and external customer value over volume of work.
* Able to shift from Servant Lead to Leader when initial or follow-up direction is needed to kickstart changes to working patterns or learned behaviour.
* Close working with Product Owner and Product Manager to curate a backlog of options for potential commitment to deliver.
* Ability to challenge and push back to defend the team to ensure focus remains on the safe delivery of value.
* Detailed knowledge of Agile practices and techniques such as (but not limited to) Story Mapping, Impact Mapping, Event Storming and Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD).
* Experience of working in a DevOps environment beneficial.
**Behavioural**
* Learner: seeks out new ideas from the worldwide Agile community, and can rapidly assimilate new knowledge, test such for applicability in-context, and apply that which has value to the team and customer.
* Critical thinker: can analyse the facts and form a judgement based on the evidence; is able to rapidly shift world view when new evidence supplants the old. All, with the aim of delivering better customer value from a motivated, happy team.
* Personable: enthusiastic, go-to member of the team who is emotionally intelligent and able to balance different emotional needs and viewpoints of team members and stakeholders.
* Servant Leader: supporting the team in achieving Better Value Sooner Safer Happier.
* Team-level Agile coach: supporting the team to discover options for improving their Agile WoW, and reason why.
* Influencer – can articulate and challenge ideas and concepts relating to agility and/or DevOps in Engineering and Product to better align outputs to outcomes delivering customer value.
* Able to work with a high degree of autonomy with team to determine effective ways to deliver value in an emergent context.
* Demonstrates high degree of Emotional Intelligence with regard to self and others.
* Encourages autonomy and ownership inside own team.
**Why Edenred PayTech?**
We are a subsidiary of the Edenred group and leaders in prepaid solutions including banking, virtual cards, debit, credit, and prepaid processing.
As an Edenred PayTech employee you will get the support and structure that you need to enjoy your work and develop your career while doing what you love and making a difference in a fast-paced and innovative business.

## **Senior E-commerce Backend Engineer: AI Native (f/m/d)**
The Senior E-commerce Backend Engineer: AI-Native is responsible to build, integrate, and expand the backend services that power the company's evolving modular e-commerce platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on connecting core e-commerce capabilities including personalization, semantic and LLM-driven search and discovery, Digital Asset Management (DAM), Product Information Management (PIM), and internal SAP/HANA systems. The role will design and develop APIs, services, data flows, and integrations that allow these platforms to work together reliably at scale. A defining requirement for this position is an AI-native development mindset: the successful candidate will use AI coding agents as a normal part of the software development lifecycle to generate, refactor, test, debug, document, and improve code while applying strong engineering judgment, security practices, and human review. The ideal candidate combines strong backend engineering fundamentals, systems integration experience, curiosity, and the ability to move quickly in a modern AI-assisted development environment. ### Essential Functions:
* Backend Platform Development: Design, build, maintain, and extend backend services, APIs, and integration layers that support Edmund Optics' modular e-commerce architecture and customer-facing web experiences
* AI-Native Software Development: Use AI coding agents and agentic development workflows as a core part of day-to-day engineering to generate, refactor, test, debug, document, and accelerate production code. Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, maintainability, and performance rather than treating generated code as automatically production-ready
* E-commerce Systems Integration: Integrate key e-commerce capabilities including personalization platforms, semantic/LLM search and discovery, DAM, PIM, analytics and data services, and other modular components as the e-commerce ecosystem evolves
* Enterprise Data & ERP Integration: Build and maintain reliable integrations between the e-commerce platform and internal enterprise systems, including SAP/HANA, product, pricing, inventory, customer, order, and other business data required to support e-commerce experiences and transactions
* API & Service Architecture: Develop scalable, secure, well-documented APIs and services that allow internal applications, third-party platforms, and customer-facing experiences to exchange data efficiently and consistently
* LLM & Semantic Capabilities: Partner with e-commerce, search, data, and AI teams to integrate LLM-enabled and semantic capabilities into the site, including retrieval, product discovery, conversational experiences, and supporting data pipelines or service layers
* Quality, Testing & Debugging: Build automated testing and validation into development workflows. Use AI-assisted debugging where appropriate while maintaining strong standards for code review, observability, performance, regression prevention, and production reliability
* Modular Architecture & Reusability: Develop services and components with clear boundaries, reusable interfaces, and maintainable integration patterns that support continued movement toward a more modular and composable e-commerce architecture
* Vendor & Partner Collaboration: Work directly with technology vendors, implementation partners, and internal teams to understand technical requirements, review integration approaches, troubleshoot issues, and translate platform capabilities into production solutions
* Continuous Improvement & Emerging Tools: Stay current with AI-assisted software development, agentic coding workflows, backend architecture, integration patterns, and emerging e-commerce technologies. Evaluate new approaches pragmatically and adopt those that measurably improve engineering speed, quality, or maintainability
### Qualifications:
To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
### Your profile:
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered
* 7+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial hands-on backend, API, or systems integration work
* Experience working with SAP and/or SAP HANA data and integration patterns
* Demonstrated recent experience using AI-assisted or agentic coding workflows in real software development, not solely experimentation or prompt-based prototyping
* Strong hands-on backend software engineering experience building production web applications, services, APIs, and integrations
* Strong engineering judgment and demonstrated ability to use AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools to write, refactor, test, debug, and document code as part of a professional software development workflow
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, service integrations, data interfaces, and modern backend application patterns
* Experience integrating multiple enterprise or SaaS platforms within a production web or e-commerce environment
* Strong understanding of databases, data modeling, SQL, system-to-system data flows, error handling, and integration reliability
* Experience with source control, automated testing, code review, CI/CD practices, logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting
* Ability to work effectively with frontend developers, architects, product and e-commerce teams, data teams, enterprise application owners, and external implementation partners
* Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and comfort working in an evolving environment where architecture and tools will continue to change
* Ability to communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Fluency in English

# Principal AI Engineer - Context - Agents and Context
Distributed Locations:
United Kingdom
-
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale - unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data - securing and protecting private information more effectively - Elastic's complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
### What is The Role:
The Context Engine team builds the knowledge layer that AI agents use to work with enterprise data in Elasticsearch. We extract knowledge from any data sources into a structured AI Index, serve it to agents through public APIs, MCP tools and framework integrations, and close the loop with agent traces so that what the engine knows improves from real usage. Any agent can use it: Elastic's own Agent Builder, Claude Code, LangChain and other third-party harnesses.
As a Principal AI Engineer, you own the improvement loop of this product end to end: how agents, automations and skills behave in production, how we observe them, how we evaluate them, and how we ship changes to them safely. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of engineering, data science, and product. You will write production code, design evaluation and telemetry that product decisions can rest on, and set the technical bar for how the team iterates on agentic behaviour. You will work alongside data scientists, backend engineers, product, and UX, and your work will show up directly in what customers build on top of Elastic.
The codebase is TypeScript and we build it in the open, so you'll be shipping code, designs and discussions in public alongside the rest of the Elastic Stack.
### What You Will Be Doing:
* Own the production improvement loop for Context Engine: understand how extraction automations, retrieval tools and memory behave, based on offline evaluations and customer conversations and telemetry. You help find the failure modes, fix them, and prove the fix.
* Define how we iterate on agents and skills safely: versioning and rollout of prompts, skills and automations, regression coverage, staged and shadow evaluation, and the guardrails that let us change behaviour without breaking customers.
* Design the telemetry we need to make data-informed engineering decisions: what to capture from agent traces, tool calls and knowledge retrieval, how it lands in Elasticsearch, and how it feeds evaluation, dashboards and the feedback loop.
* Partner with the data science team on evaluation strategy: golden datasets, evaluators to gate on quality, latency and cost.
* Raise the bar across the team: review designs and PRs, mentor engineers in eval-driven development, and write the technical proposals that shape the roadmap.
### What You Bring:
* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with the recent years spent shipping and operating AI-driven products on real production traffic, ideally products with public APIs and data models that had to evolve without breaking customers.
* A track record of eval-driven product improvement: you have diagnosed agent or LLM behaviour from traces and user feedback, designed the evaluation that exposed the problem, shipped the fix and measured the outcome.
* Direct experience building agents with state and memory, and iterating on prompts, skills and tool behaviour safely in production.
* Familiarity with MCP, including exposing public MCP servers and tools.
* Experience designing telemetry for AI systems, and using it to make engineering and product decisions.
* Experience running product experiments end to end: instrumentation, unattended execution, and interpreting results.
* Experience building products with public APIs and evolving data models, and the judgement that comes with maintaining external contracts as a product changes.
* Strong backend engineering skills in either Python or TypeScript: APIs, stateful workflows, data pipelines and production services.
* Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and product managers as peers, translating between measurement and shipping, and communicating trade-offs clearly.
* A pragmatic, low-ego style suited to a distributed, async-first team.
### Bonus Points:
* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, or similar.
* Agentic retrieval experience, including knowledge representation.
* Practical Elasticsearch experience.
### Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you're looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn't matter if you're just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

# **Senior Business Analyst – AI Innovation**
## **About Our Team**
Digital Business Solutions (DBS) delivers innovation and solves customer and business problems by leveraging the power of technology, data, and — increasingly — AI. Within DBS, the AI Innovation team focuses specifically on identifying and delivering agentic and generative AI capabilities across our Salesforce ecosystem and adjacent platforms. We partner with customers, authors, editors, and Elsevier colleagues to drive intelligent automation, frictionless personalised experiences, and streamlined processes that support cost optimisation and growth. We provide the expertise to understand business challenges and translate them into practical, responsible AI-enabled solutions.
## **About the Role**
The Senior Business Analyst will work with business units and technology teams to identify, scope, and deliver AI innovation opportunities across our Salesforce platform landscape — including Salesforce Agentforce, Data Cloud (Data 360), and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based integrations, as well as adjacent AI tooling. The role focuses on hunting for value opportunities for sales teams; understanding the data and process foundations required to ground AI agents; and defining requirements and functional specifications that bridge business needs with emerging AI capabilities.
## **Responsibilities**
* Partner with business and product teams to identify opportunities where AI agents, automation, and data unification can remove friction, reduce cost, or improve customer/employee experience
* Document current-state business processes and design future-state processes that incorporate Salesforce Agentforce agents, Data Cloud (Data 360), and MCP-based integrations
* Gather business requirements, high-level user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI agent workflows — including agent actions, guardrails, escalation paths, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints
* Assess data readiness for AI use cases (data quality, identity resolution, harmonisation) in partnership with data engineering teams supporting Data 360
* Plan and facilitate workshops to scope AI/agentic use cases, evaluate feasibility, and align stakeholders on priority and sequencing
* Work with technology teams (Salesforce, data engineering, AI/ML engineers) to produce detailed user stories and acceptance criteria that support development and QA, including for Agentforce agent builds and MCP server/tool integrations
* Maintain stakeholder expectations, communicate trade-offs of AI-driven solutions (accuracy, latency, cost, risk), and raise issues to project/product managers as needed
* Develop "trusted advisor" relationships with senior stakeholders through effective communication about AI capabilities, limitations, and responsible use
* Perform analysis on existing systems and processes to identify where AI/agentic solutions are technically and commercially viable versus where traditional automation is a better fit
* Track the evolving Agentforce, Data Cloud, and MCP/agentic-AI landscape, and translate relevant developments into concrete opportunities for the business
* Support change management and user adoption for AI-driven process changes, including documentation and enablement materials
## **Requirements**
* Proven experience in process modelling (BPMN standard), eliciting business requirements, and translating them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria
* Hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform (Sales Cloud / Service Cloud); working knowledge of, or strong interest in, **Salesforce Agentforce** and **Data Cloud (Data 360)**
* Working familiarity with core AI/agentic concepts — prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, and **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** — sufficient to translate business needs into technical requirements
* Understanding of data architecture fundamentals (data unification, identity resolution, data quality) as they relate to grounding AI agents on trustworthy data
* Solid understanding of software development methodologies, platforms, and tools, including how AI/agentic components fit into standard SDLC
* Demonstrated ability to plan and facilitate small to medium-sized workshops, including cross-functional AI use-case discovery sessions
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI/technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and vice versa
* Hands-on experience working in agile environments using recognised delivery frameworks such as Agile, Scrum, and Kanban
* Experience performing the Business Analyst role across the full software development lifecycle
* Experience with Lead-to-Cash processes and Salesforce
* Exposure to data analytics and data-driven decision-making, and familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, Microsoft Office, and Microsoft Teams
* A genuine curiosity about AI and a habit of continuous learning — this space moves fast, and the role requires staying current
### **Nice to Have**
* Exposure to Salesforce Einstein, Copilot Studio, or comparable generative AI platform features

# **Job Summary**
We are looking for a Product Engineer to join our AI Search and Retrieval Context Engineering as we build the next generation of legal AI experiences for law firms.
This is not a traditional front-end developer role where requirements are handed over and built from a specification. It is a hands-on product engineering role for someone who can understand the problem, shape the user experience, think through the system design and then build high-quality software.
The role is primarily focused on React, TypeScript and modern user experience development, but the expectation is broader than UI delivery. You will work close to lawyers, knowledge teams, innovation teams and technical stakeholders to understand how AI search, retrieval and agents should fit into real legal workflows.
We are not building another disconnected AI chatbot. We are building trusted AI experiences that sit on top of the firm’s own documents, knowledge, matters, metadata and workflows.
As a Product Engineer, you will help turn complex AI retrieval capability into simple, useful and trusted experiences for lawyers.
# **Why This Role Matters**
AI is changing software engineering. The value of an engineer is no longer only in writing code quickly. AI can now help generate code, tests and components at speed. That makes the human part of engineering more important, not less.
The best engineers are now the ones who understand the system, the user, the constraints and the business problem.
For this team, that means understanding why a lawyer is searching, what they need to trust an answer, what happens if the wrong document is surfaced, how permissions work, how citations should be displayed, and how the experience fits into their daily workflow.
A button is not just a button. A search result is not just a card. An AI answer is not just text on a page.
In legal AI, every interaction has to support trust, explainability, security and adoption.
That is why we need Product Engineers: people who are fluent in engineering, fluent in product thinking, and willing to understand the domain deeply enough to build the right thing.
# **About the Team**
The Search & AI team helps law firms build secure, firm-specific AI capabilities on top of their existing document, knowledge and matter infrastructure.
We work with firms that want to move beyond standalone AI tools and create a trusted AI layer inside their own environment. Our solutions typically connect to systems such as iManage, SharePoint, NetDocuments, Microsoft 365, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI and internal knowledge platforms.
The team already has experience delivering AI search and workflow capabilities for a Magic Circle law firm and a global multinational law firm, including natural language search, agents and Azure-based retrieval solutions built in partnership with Microsoft.
As the market shifts from AI adoption to AI ownership, our team is becoming more like a Forward Deployment Engineering function: technical people who work close to strategic clients, understand their workflows, and build real solutions that move from prototype to production.
# **The Role**
You will design and build the product experience layer for legal AI.
That includes search interfaces, AI answer experiences, document previews, citation views, agent workflows, feedback loops, dashboards, admin screens and embedded components for tools lawyers already use.
You will mainly work in React and TypeScript, building polished, enterprise-grade applications that are fast, accessible, secure and suitable for professional legal users.
You will work with AI engineers, retrieval architects, Azure engineers, legal knowledge experts and client stakeholders to turn complex technical capabilities into clear, usable products.
# **What You Will Build**
You may build a natural language search experience that allows lawyers to ask questions across a firm’s knowledge bank and receive grounded answers with citations.
You may create a source preview panel that lets a lawyer inspect the exact document behind an AI answer before relying on it.
You may design an agent workflow where a lawyer can run a research task, review retrieved documents, refine the question, compare outputs and export the result.
You may build dashboards that show search quality, adoption, answer confidence, feedback trends and retrieval performance.
You may create embedded components for SharePoint, Teams, Word, Outlook or a firm intranet, so AI appears inside the workflow rather than as another destination.
The common thread is that you will be building the experience layer that makes AI usable, explainable and trusted.
# **Key Responsibilities**
**Build high-quality React and TypeScript applications**
You will build modern front-end applications using React, TypeScript and strong component design. You will care about performance, accessibility, responsiveness, error handling, loading states, empty states, maintainability and the overall quality of the user experience. You will work with APIs, authentication, permissions, search services, AI responses, document metadata and workflow actions.
**Shape the product, not just the code**
You will help define how legal AI experiences should work. This means challenging unclear requirements, simplifying complex workflows, proposing better interaction patterns and making sure the team is building something users will actually adopt. You will not just wait for a perfect specification. You will help create it.
**Understand the lawyer workflow**
You will work close to legal users and client teams to understand how lawyers search for knowledge, review documents, validate answers and move through their work. The goal is to build AI into workflows lawyers already understand, rather than sending them to another disconnected tool.
**Turn AI retrieval into trusted UX**
You will design interfaces that make retrieval transparent. This includes citations, source previews, metadata, snippets, filters, document cards, confidence signals, feedback mechanisms and audit-friendly interaction patterns. In legal AI, the user needs to understand where an answer came from and why it should be trusted.
**Work across the system**
Although this is mainly a React and TypeScript role, you will need to understand how your UI fits into the wider system. That may include Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, retrieval APIs, MCP-style tool access, document processing pipelines, security trimming, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, iManage or other enterprise systems. You do not need to own every layer, but you should understand how the layers connect.
**Use AI as part of your engineering workflow**
We expect Product Engineers to use AI effectively in their own work. That may include using AI to generate code drafts, test ideas, explore components, accelerate refactoring or support documentation. But the judgement remains yours. AI can help write code. It cannot own the product intent, system consequences or user trust.

You should have strong hands-on experience with React and TypeScript.
You should be comfortable building component-based applications, working with APIs, handling complex state and delivering polished enterprise user interfaces. Experience with Next.js would be useful, but is not essential.
You should understand modern front-end development practices, including authentication flows, role-based permissions, asynchronous data, loading states, error states, accessibility, testing, source control and CI/CD.

# **Product Engineering Mindset**
The strongest candidates will think beyond tickets.
You should be someone who wants to understand why something is being built, not just how to build it. You should be comfortable working in ambiguity, forming a point of view, testing ideas quickly and improving based on feedback.
You should care about systems. You should want to understand how the UI, API, retrieval layer, permissions model and user workflow fit together.
You should be able to see where a small UI decision could create confusion, risk or unnecessary friction.
You should also care about product quality. Legal users are time-poor and sceptical of poor AI experiences. The interface needs to be clear, reliable and professional.
This is a role for someone who wants to use engineering judgement, product instinct and domain understanding together.
# AI and Search Awareness
You will work around AI search and retrieval systems, so you should be interested in concepts such as retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, vector search, hybrid search, document chunking, citations, source grounding, prompt workflows and agentic interfaces.
You do not need to build all of this from scratch, but you do need to understand enough to design good user experiences around it.
For example, when an AI answer is shown, the UI should help the lawyer answer practical questions: Where did this answer come from? Can I open the source? Is this the latest version? Which jurisdiction does this relate to? Who authored it? Can I trust this document? What should I do next?
That is product engineering in legal AI.

Success means the team builds AI products that lawyers actually use.
A successful search experience will help a lawyer find the right precedent, legal opinion or knowledge document quickly and confidently.
A successful answer experience will make the source material visible, citeable and easy to inspect.
A successful agent workflow will guide the user through a complex task without hiding important decisions.
A successful product will feel simple on the surface, even though the system underneath is complex.
More broadly, success means helping law firms move from AI experimentation to AI capability they can trust, own and scale.

This team sits at the centre of that shift.

# Study Start Up and Regulatory Affairs Specialist (2 years plus experience)
* Full-time
* Department: Study Start up and Regulatory Unit
## Company Description
Medicine moves forward here. So will you.
Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.
We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.
That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.
If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.
## Job Description
The Specialist, Study Start Up and Regulatory Affairs leads and coordinates all activities related to achieving site initiation readiness. The role provides subject matter expertise, ensures regulatory compliance, and serves as a key liaison between internal teams, clients, and external stakeholders
* Accountable for delivery of assigned study start-up and regulatory milestones within defined scope.
* Make independent decisions within assigned scope regarding regulatory processes and documentation approaches.
* Handles medium-complexity regulatory environments, including multi-country requirements where applicable.
* Leads study start-up and regulatory activities for assigned countries or projects of medium complexity, ensuring delivery in line with timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Leads preparation, review, and quality control of regulatory and study start-up documentation (including submissions, essential documents, and translations) to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with ICH-GCP and country-specific requirements.
* Responsible for drafting, negotiating, finalizing, and executing clinical site agreements, ancillary agreements as well as amendments at country or regional level, in accordance with project requirements and country regulations and within the projected delivery timelines
* Review all relevant documentation e.g. labels, patient information sheets, diary cards, insurance etc, to ensure compliance with ICH GCP & country specific requirements.
* Contribute towards the preparation and/or review of complex technical/scientific/legal documentation.
* Arrange for and/or review translation of essential documents as required
* Provide regulatory/SSU strategic input to internal and external customers. Develop the regulatory strategy and the SSU Plan, joint operating procedures and core documents
* Promptly identify and escalate risk/potential risk to the project team which may jeopardise deliverables; support corrective/preventive actions
* Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
## Qualifications
* Graduate degree in Chemistry or Life Sciences, Nursing or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Minimum 2 years within pharmaceutical or CRO industry or Regulatory body
* Good knowledge of ICH GCP and national regulations for territories of competency
* Good understanding of specific country requirements pertaining to SSU/Regulatory delivery in multiple countries within Europe and/or the Americas
## Additional Information
When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.
We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.
* Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
* Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
* Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
* Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
* Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
* Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.
We look forward to welcoming your application.

****About us****
The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.
At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.
In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.
Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.
*Build a newsworthy career at the FT.*
**The Role**
The role of deputy big read editor is one of the most exciting editing jobs at the FT, with the chance to shape and work on a wide range of agenda-setting journalism.
The big read is one of the FT’s showpieces, addressing the issues that most matter to our readers. It needs to do so with authority, verve and innovation, making a strong claim to the standalone slot on the app and home page six times a week. A central part of the team’s work is collaboration with other desks - particularly visual storytelling and visual investigations, with whom we cooperate deeply on a regular stream of outstanding articles.
Big reads are critical to the FT’s mission. They help us understand and communicate what’s happening in the world - whether it is Chinese exports or the rise of Revolut, falling birth rates or Apple’s back story, Ukraine’s fightback or AI on the loose. Helping conceive, refine and project these memorable articles is deeply rewarding - and can be a blast.
The main responsibilities of the deputy big read editor include
* Generating ideas for a broad range of feature stories that reflect the core priorities of the FT. Each piece should have an angle, a notable new fact, a point and a purpose. Commissioning also involves thinking about format: storytelling is about more than large slabs of text.
* Conducting a rigorous and on deadline edit of longform pieces, working closely with writers across the organisations and ensuring that copy is sparkling and legally watertight every time. Each day’s big read should shine and make its mark for the FT.
* Leading the desk when the Big Read editor is away and regularly representing the team in news conference and other meetings.
* Developing and managing special projects that will be showcases for FT journalism.
* Working with the visual storytelling team and other desks.
**Your skills**
* The news instinct and capacity to identify the topics and ideas that make outstanding big reads.
* Proven ability and a flair for editing longform pieces about varied topics - including tech, business and finance, science and economics.
* The confidence to discuss and debate ideas with the FT’s most senior editors and writers. The skill to help whittle story pitches and nut pars down to their essentials, telling the reader something novel and memorable.
* The diplomacy needed to work with reporters, correspondents and editors on other desks who face multiple demands on their time. The skill to help manage the big read team and to develop younger talent among reporters, editors and other colleagues.
* An aptitude for visual storytelling and using graphics in a creative way.
* The capacity to work to tight deadlines and under pressure, while taking pleasure from helping make some of the FT’s best work even better.
****Please submit your application by the end of the day, Monday 5th October 2026.****

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.
We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role.
Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

# Senior Director, Engineering – Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns
**Fitch Ratings**
---
## The Opportunity
Fitch Ratings is looking for a builder, a challenger, and a boundary-pusher to lead the engineering organization responsible for all applications and services powering our Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns lines of business. This is not a role for someone who optimizes within the status quo — it's a role for someone who questions it, reimagines it, and has the courage and capability to do something about it.
As Senior Director, you will have executive ownership of four engineering teams comprising a couple of dozen engineers. You'll lead a talented, multidisciplinary group tackling some of the most consequential technology challenges in global financial intelligence — maintaining and evolving the systems that analysts and clients depend on today, while simultaneously building the next generation of platforms from a position of real creative freedom and organizational backing.
This is a role for someone who moves fast, experiments boldly, and doesn't wait for permission to try something new. Someone who has broken things in the pursuit of building something better, who sees constraints as invitations to be clever, and who brings an infectious sense of possibility that raises the ambition of everyone around them. If you've spent time deep in machine learning or AI systems — not just using them, but building them — that's not just a bonus, it's the kind of background that makes this opportunity even more compelling. But this role goes far beyond any single discipline: it's about leading a culture of relentless innovation across every dimension of how software gets built and delivered.
---
## We'll Count on You To
**Challenge the conventional and set a bolder technical vision** Own the strategic direction, execution, and engineering culture of four high-performing full-stack engineering teams. But more than managing what exists — interrogate it. Ask the uncomfortable questions about why things are built the way they are, and lead your teams toward answers that are smarter, faster, and more powerful. Set a technical vision that doesn't just improve the current state but genuinely reimagines what's possible for the platforms powering Fitch's most critical analytical work.
**Build, develop, and inspire exceptional people** Lead, mentor, and empower a team of team leads and engineers across a range of technical backgrounds and experience levels. Foster a culture where intellectual curiosity is celebrated, where experimentation is encouraged, and where people feel safe enough to take risks and learn loudly from what doesn't work. Attract and retain engineers who are hungry, inventive, and proud of both the quality of what they ship today and the audacity of what they're building toward.
**Reimagine and modernize critical platforms** Oversee the full lifecycle of the applications and services central to Fitch's Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns analytical workflows. Balance the discipline of maintaining production-grade systems with the creative ambition to tear down and rebuild what no longer serves the business well. Be the person in the room who asks "what if we started over?" — and who knows when that's exactly the right call.
**Drive greenfield innovation without apology** Identify and actively pursue opportunities to design and build net-new applications and platforms that replace or leapfrog legacy approaches. Embrace the blank canvas — and bring the rigor of world-class software delivery with you. This is an organization that wants to see bets placed, experiments run, and lessons learned fast. Be the kind of leader who creates that energy and channels it into things that last.
**Push the frontier of AI, ML, and intelligent systems** Go beyond adopting AI tools — define how intelligent systems become structural, load-bearing parts of the platforms your teams own. Whether that's LLM-powered workflows, ML models embedded in analytical processes, agentic automation, or AI-augmented developer tooling, bring the depth to evaluate, architect, and champion these capabilities with real technical conviction. If you've built ML systems from the ground up, that experience will resonate deeply here — and you'll have the platform to apply it in genuinely high-stakes, high-visibility ways.
**Influence across a complex and interconnected stakeholder landscape** Act as a strategic partner to a broad and diverse set of stakeholders — including senior leadership, analytical teams, operations, and business relationship management — whose workflows and outcomes depend directly on the platforms your teams own. Navigate a rich ecosystem of technical interdependencies, partnering with peer engineering teams whose systems integrate with, depend on, or are shaped by what your teams build. Build organizational credibility through consistent delivery, clear technical vision, and the ability to bring bold ideas to life in ways that earn trust across the business.
---
## What You Need to Have
* **18+ years of hands-on software engineering experience**, with substantial time in senior technical leadership roles overseeing multiple teams and disciplines
* **Proven multi-team leadership** — demonstrated experience leading team leads and engineers across full-stack disciplines; a track record of building high-performing, inventive engineering cultures at meaningful scale
* **Deep technical credibility and hands-on instinct** — strong command of modern software architecture, cloud-native platforms, and production-grade application delivery; you know when to go deep, and your teams and peers will know it too
* **Full-stack engineering expertise** — proven background with modern enterprise technology stacks, including React, Java, and/or Python in production environments, deployed across AWS and/or Azure
* **A bias for experimentation and innovation** — a demonstrable history of pushing technical boundaries, challenging inherited assumptions, and driving teams toward approaches that are meaningfully better — not just incrementally improved
* **Modernization and greenfield experience** — proven ability to evolve existing platforms while simultaneously designing and delivering new systems; comfort making bold architectural decisions in both constrained legacy and open greenfield environments
* **People leadership and talent development** — demonstrated ability to attract, grow, and retain exceptional engineers and engineering leaders; a builder of teams as much as systems, with a genuine investment in the growth of the people around you
* **Cross-functional stakeholder management** — proven ability to partner effectively across analytical, operational, and business-facing teams as well as peer technical organizations; skilled at managing competing priorities and driving alignment across a complex interdependency landscape
* **Executive communication** — the ability to translate bold technical vision for non-technical audiences, build trust through delivery, and make complex ideas land clearly at every level of the organization
* **Education:** Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field — or equivalent expertise demonstrated through impact
---
## What Would Make You Stand Out
* **An ML or AI engineering background** — if you've spent meaningful time building machine learning systems, training models, designing intelligent pipelines, or architecting AI-native applications, that depth is genuinely exciting for this role and will shape how you lead, what you build, and the kind of talent you attract
* **Deep cloud-native expertise** — hands-on mastery of AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, microservices architecture, and sophisticated CI/CD and deployment pipelines for large-scale application delivery
* **Generative AI and intelligent systems experience** — hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, or production ML systems; the ability to move between engineering credibility and strategic vision without losing altitude
* **AI-native delivery leadership** — direct experience implementing AI-augmented development lifecycles, intelligent testing pipelines, or AI-assisted tooling that materially raises the quality and velocity of engineering teams
* **Transformation and platform modernization leadership** — a history of successfully reimagining complex, production-critical platforms while maintaining delivery continuity and rallying teams around a compelling future state
* **A maverick streak with enterprise judgment** — the rare combination of someone who genuinely challenges conventions and moves with urgency, but knows how to do it within a complex organization without losing stakeholders along the way
* **Financial services domain knowledge** — familiarity with analytical workflows, credit ratings processes, or how technology creates leverage in financial decision-making
* **Technical thought leadership** — contributing to open source, speaking at industry events, publishing engineering content, or establishing technical direction that influences well beyond your immediate team
---

* **Executive visibility and strategic influence** — direct access to senior leadership, the platform to shape engineering direction across consequential lines of business, and the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on how global financial intelligence is delivered

* **A place where ML and AI expertise becomes architecture** — if you've built intelligent systems, this is an environment where that knowledge doesn't sit on the shelf; it shapes product direction, platform design, and how the organization thinks about what's next
* **Cutting-edge technology and continuous learning** — access to the latest AI tools, frameworks, platforms; training and conference budgets; and the expectation that you'll stay at the leading edge and pull your teams forward with you
* **Career acceleration at scale** — high visibility to the most senior leaders at Fitch, a clear path to principal and executive roles, and the opportunity to define what AI-driven financial technology looks like in practice
* **A culture that rewards curiosity** — an environment where bold ideas are welcomed, where experimentation is celebrated, and where the best thinking wins regardless of where it comes from

When was the last time you made a new friend? The quality of your relationships is the single most important factor for your mental health. Travel has a unique ability to fast-forward the friendship-making process, which is why we’re on a mission to create one million meaningful friendships using the power of travel and technology as a platform for human connection.

We're hiring a People Partner to join our People team. We have a lean team and you'll be working closely with our Head of People & Talent to build the frameworks, programmes and ways of working that help our people do their best work in a remote-first world.
You'll own and deliver key projects across the People lifecycle such as onboarding, probations, growth and development, performance management and be a trusted partner to our managers, helping them bring to life and embed the things we're building. **The design philosophy**
At Fyxer, design starts with human behaviour rather than with screens, components or flows. We think the best product decisions come from understanding why people do what they do, and working back from there. It isn't a principle we put on a wall. It's how we make decisions.
**What you're walking into**
We're not starting from zero. We have a creative designer on the team, a visual identity built with Red Antler, a design system, and a product that real users depend on every day.
What we don't have is a senior product design voice. Someone who gets the first call across the company when a product, experience or communication decision needs a human-behaviour lens on it.
That's this role. You'll report to our Head of Product and work as the sole designer, an early design hire, alongside our engineers. You'll be the most senior product design hire we've made, with real influence over what gets built and over how this company thinks about the people it builds for.
If you think understanding people is the hardest and most important part of design, and that everything else follows from that, this is the role for you.
**What we care about, in order**
*01. Human behaviour first*
You think in motivation, habit and friction before you think in screens. You understand why people do what they do, and you use that to make product decisions, not just design decisions.
*02. Craft and execution*
You ship. You work directly with engineers and move fast without losing the quality that makes a product feel premium.
*03. AI-native workflows*
You understand how modern engineers build with AI tools, and you think about design in that context. We care about principles, components and systems that plug into engineering workflows rather than sitting in static documentation. You're comfortable working close to implementation, and you help keep experiences coherent while teams move quickly with AI-assisted development.
**What you'll be working on**
Fyxer is an AI-powered productivity platform. You'll design interfaces where the AI does real work: raising something people missed, live transcription, deeply personalised drafts, complex cross-surface workflows. They need to feel effortless despite genuine complexity underneath.

* A real-time notetaker that generates live transcripts and captures the right context

We're intentional about our team. A small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organisation.

* Velocity: you'll be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

**Overview of the Department**
Respiratory, Immunology and Inflammation (RII) Biostatistics is part of the RII Research Unit (RIIRU), a department focused on developing innovative medicines for respiratory, immune and inflammatory diseases. RII statisticians play a key role throughout the research and development of the drug pipeline, working closely with scientists, clinicians in areas such as medicine discovery, clinical trial design and statistical analysis. We provide statistical expertise in the design of studies and clinical trials (e.g. sample size determination and randomisation strategies), as well as the performing analysis and providing interpretation of data.

* Support professional statisticians in the design of studies and clinical trials (e.g. sample size determination and randomisation).
* Work with professional statisticians in preparing statistical analysis plans, model development, output QC, and the communication of results.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. scientists, clinicians).
* Develop statistical programming skills in R and other software.
* Develop an understanding of statistical methods used throughout drug development.
* Learn and apply statistical methods through project work and internal training on advanced topics e.g. Quantitative Decision Making, Bayesian Dynamic Borrowing, Dose Response Modelling, etc.
**Role 2 - Clinical Programming and Business Excellence -** **GSK HQ London**
Degree requirements - Preferably Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a Science/Technology related discipline.

Clinical Programming play a critical role within the Biostatistics department. We support clinical research teams by performing programming and validation of datasets and outputs for the analysis and reporting of clinical trial data. Meanwhile ensuring data quality, accuracy and adherence to data standards and regulatory requirements. Clinical Programming collaborate closely with cross-functional teams such as Statistics, Data Management and Clinical teams to ensure data is fit for purpose and meets requirements for study analysis and reporting. This placement year will provide you with exposure to industry-standard tools, methodologies, and regulatory requirements while contributing to the advancement of life-changing therapies. You will gain an insight into cutting-edge clinical research and the development processes, with the opportunity to learn from and network with experienced professionals within GSK.
Key Placement Learnings
* Collaborate with statisticians and fellow professional programmers as part of a study team to develop datasets, tables, listings and figures to aid clinical trial reporting.
* Participate in programming activities for clinical trial reporting using SAS and/or R programming languages, whilst adhering to data standards and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct quality control checks on clinical trial data and outputs, identifying and resolving discrepancies or issues where possible and flagging data issues to necessary stakeholders.
* Assist in the preparation of standard documentation, including dataset specifications and reviewer guides.
* Opportunities to be involved in and contribute to other non-project initiatives within GSK, contributing towards development of the Biostatistics department.

Degree requirements - Mathematics, Statistics, Data Sciences
Overview of the Department
This is an exciting opportunity to join GSK and gain exposure for innovation in the field of Statistics and Data Science to help transform the way in which we use data and quantitative thinking to drive decision-making in R&D. We are growing our cutting-edge statistical innovation and data science capabilities by expanding the Quantitative Sciences Innovation (QSI) group led by Nicky Best. QSI is a methodologically focused, solution-oriented functional group within GSK’s Biostatistics department.
Key Placement Learnings
* Collaborate with your team to develop and explore novel methods for handling prediction problems
* Gain hands on coding experience developing Machine Learning and prediction modelling pipelines
* Understand the background and statistical methods important for drug development
* Provide analysis, reporting and interpretation of modelling projects
* Work in close consultation with professional methodologists and scientists working in medicine and vaccine development
* Become proficient in R programming and Python. Leverage version control through GitHub to enable collaboration
* Develop new skills working in an ‘agile’ way delivering on projects over short ‘sprints’
* Learn the theory of new statistical and machine learning methodologies and how to apply it by collaborating with highly skilled statisticians and attending training courses
* Experience the role of a statistical consultant, working closely with cross-functional teams to translate scientific or clinical problems into statistical ones
* Gain industry knowledge in potentially a wide range of therapeutic areas, overseeing short-term or long-term projects that cover multiple GSK drugs

Global Clinical Operations is a multidisciplinary department within which the Non-Interventional Study (NIS) Project Management team sit. The NIS Project Management team are a global team that manage project plans to operationalise evidence generation activities to demonstrate the value of our medicines to Regulators, Payers and Healthcare Professionals. * Build and manage Project Plans in Planisware aligned to evidence generation strategies, gaining insight into the breadth of evidence generation activities and their contribution to the overall drug development process.
* Maintain active project plans, including timelines, budgets and new activities, developing practical project management skills while ensuring activities are delivered on schedule and within budget expectations.

Degrees required: Relevant Life Sciences degree (e.g., Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacology, Biochemistry, or similar).

Overview of the Department
Clinical Sciences & Operations is the function within ViiV Healthcare responsible for the scientific design, execution and delivery of clinical development programmes. Working across global, cross-functional teams, the department supports the progression of innovative HIV medicines from study concept and protocol development through to study execution, regulatory submission and reporting. The team collaborates closely with a wide range of stakeholders, including Clinical Pharmacology, Medical and Commercial teams, to ensure clinical studies are conducted to the highest scientific, ethical and quality standards.
Key Placement Learnings

* Develop an understanding of clinical drug development, including study design, protocol development and the generation of clinical evidence to support HIV medicines.
* Gain hands-on experience supporting the delivery of global clinical studies, working alongside cross-functional teams to help ensure studies are conducted in line with protocols, timelines and quality requirements.
* Build critical thinking and data literacy skills through the review and interpretation of clinical and safety data, contributing to evidence-based decision making.
* Enhance scientific communication skills by supporting the preparation of clinical study reports, presentations and regulatory documents that communicate study outcomes.
* Strengthen collaboration and stakeholder management skills by working with colleagues across Clinical Pharmacology, Medical, Commercial and other global functions.
* Develop key professional capabilities including project management, adaptability, initiative, time management and an appreciation of working within a highly regulated GxP environment.

Workplace Arrangements: Flexible working via performance with choice (office and home working available)

The Clinical Supply Team’s (CST) focus is on patient safety, ethical trial conduct, and cost-effective supply solutions to support ViiV Healthcare's mission of advancing HIV treatments and research. Fit for supply’, ‘fit for distribution and storage’, ‘fit for Medical Professional and Patient Use’. CST is responsible for ensuring the compliant, seamless delivery of investigational medicinal products (IMPs) for supported clinical trials. They manage the supply of pipeline and launched products, ensuring that therapies are available for patients without interruption. The team works cross-functionally with Study Supply Leads, Regulatory, Procurement, Global Medical, Finance, and other stakeholders to develop supply strategies, maintain compliance with global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, cGMP, GDP, GCP), and optimize operational efficiency. CST falls within Global Medical Sciences which is the function that bridges research, development, and medical affairs to support the scientific and clinical development of HIV therapies. GMS focuses on translating scientific insights into actionable strategies, driving innovation in HIV care, and ensuring ethical and compliant clinical trial conduct to improve patient outcomes.

* Supply Strategy Execution: Supporting Study Supply Leads (SSLs) in developing and implementing VH Product supply strategies to maintain uninterrupted therapy and compliance.
* Operational & Organisational Support: Utilising strong organisational skills to prioritise tasks, ensure accuracy, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment while supporting CST operations & supply chain initiatives.
* Data Management and Analysis: Ensuring accuracy and integrity of data across clinical supply systems, analysing trends, and utilizing tools like Excel and Power BI for informed decision-making.
* Stakeholder Communication: Maintaining and overseeing real-time communication & digital tools to manage interactions with internal teams, external vendors, and matrix functions.
* Audit Readiness and Compliance: Preparing for audits by ensuring data integrity, adherence to regulatory requirements (cGMP, GDP, GCP), and archiving quality-checked documentation.
* Financial Oversight: Supporting budgeting, forecasting, invoice tracking, and resolution of finance-related issues within the clinical supply program.

## Description
**Job Title: Head, Global Market Access and Pricing**
**Job Purpose:**
Lead the Global Market Access and Pricing function for ViiV Healthcare, building access and pricing strategies for the current and future portfolio. Working with cross-functional partners, the role ensures payer, HTA and pricing requirements are embedded early in asset strategy, target product profiles, Brand strategy, Integrated Evidence Plans, development decisions, value communication and launch readiness, enabling broad and timely access for people living with HIV and people who could benefit from prevention while protecting long-term portfolio value.
* Deliver strategic market access and pricing recommendations for pipeline assets, including early input into target product profiles, evidence generation, forecasting and asset strategy.
* Ensure Payers/HTA agencies recognize and reward future HIV innovation
* Sustain and optimise the value of the portfolio. Prepare for emerging competition and lifecycle opportunities.
* Provide strategic leadership and ensure effective monitoring and navigation of the evolving external pricing and market access landscape.
* Lead robust and disciplined price governance decision making for price setting and maintenance globally
* Accelerate digital, data and AI-enabled market access ways of working
* Lead, coach and develop a high-performing global market access and pricing organization
As a key commercial leader within ViiV and a member of the Global Commercial Strategy Leadership Team, the role provides an enterprise leadership opportunity.
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Portfolio access and value strategy & execution**
* Design global product and portfolio pricing and access strategies that support access for PLHIV and PWBP while delivering long-term value for ViiV Healthcare.
* Lead development of differentiated payer value propositions, value communication tools, pricing strategies and access plans for launch, pipeline and lifecycle assets.
* Partner with R&D, Commercial, Medical/Health Outcomes, RWE, Government Affairs, Policy, Finance and Regional/Local teams to ensure payer insights and requirements are embedded early within asset strategy and development decisions.
* Ensure Payer insights and needs are represented in strategy development, forecasting, launch & indication sequencing, integrated evidence generation plans, business planning, and launch excellence processes.
* Support Region and key LOCs with pricing & access strategy localization, launch preparation and launch risk mitigation.
* Optimise global-to-local ways of working through best-practice sharing, performance metrics, clear accountabilities and integration with pricing and HTA trends.
* Execute plans effectively through Region and LOC plans, focusing on excellent operationalisation and implementation of strategy. Ensure a clear focus on outcomes and behaviour change, not activity.
* Deliver measurable positive impact of pricing and access strategies on product and portfolio outcomes.
**External environment**
* Increase payer, HTA and policymaker receptivity to the value of HIV innovation
* Monitor payer, HTA, policy, pricing and competitor trends globally, and distil implications with scenario planning and recommendations as appropriate.
**Pricing governance and value preservation**
* Chair and evolve the global Price Governance framework, overseeing price setting, price maintenance and alignment to global access and pricing strategy.
* Document, monitor and assess the effectiveness, risk and financial exposure of pricing and access decisions, escalating insights for proactive management as required.
