## AI for the many, not the few
Mindstone learns what works in AI adoption through our work with clients and our community, builds those insights into training, community and Rebel, our AI-powered agentic OS, then brings what works to more people, measure what works and iterate. Our customers include Pearson, Home Depot, Hyatt and Delta Airlines. Our mission is to make the benefits of AI available beyond the people who build the technology.
We live in the future we’re building. Our team uses Rebel to run the company, tests new ways of working and helps others put them into practice.
We’re hiring someone to turn good intentions into things that actually happen: a well-run team gathering, a commitment followed through, an office that works, a process nobody needs to chase. That gives the CEO and team more time to focus on the work only they can do.
## What you’ll get
* **Learn how a company runs, from the inside.** Work directly with the CEO and closely with the COO, with exposure to decisions, trade-offs and the work behind them.
* **Responsibility, not just observation.** Own work from idea to completion, with room to decide how it gets done and support when you need it.
* **Practical experience at the AI frontier.** A generous AI budget and daily use of Rebel: you’ll develop ways of working you can take throughout your career.
* **People and experiences beyond the office.** Build relationships with founders, AI practitioners and senior leaders from organisations such as Home Depot, Hyatt and Pearson. There are opportunities to travel if you want them, and to join conversations where leaders work through what AI means for their organisations.
* **Room to grow towards Chief of Staff.** Start with hands-on operations and executive support, then take on more complex projects as your judgement and understanding of the business develop. Progression depends on your development and the company’s needs, not a promised timetable.
## What you’ll actually do
**Own projects from start to finish.** Think through what each project needs, who it affects and what could go wrong, then take responsibility for getting it done. You’ll also arrange travel and handle a small amount of diary coordination and meeting preparation, but the substance of the role is project ownership.
**Run the practical side of working together.** Keep office logistics and suppliers organised. Coordinate travel, bookings and itineraries. Spot recurring friction and fix the process, rather than repeatedly rescuing it.
**Organise Swarm Week and AI Breakthrough Weekends.** Coordinate our team gathering and AI events, from schedules, venues and travel to materials and follow-through. Help people arrive prepared and leave clear on what happens next.
**Support the community.** Help organise events and activities, coordinate participants and practical arrangements, and make people feel welcome and informed.
**Build better ways of working.** Use Rebel daily to organise work and automate repeatable tasks. Check AI outputs, protect confidential information and leave clear records so someone else can pick things up.
Success means people know what’s happening, commitments don’t get lost and the same problems need less attention over time.
## Who thrives here
This could suit someone early in their operations career or moving into it from another path. We care about how you work, not a particular degree or number of years on your CV. The frontier shifts quickly, so you need an exceptional willingness to change, evolve and learn.
Our true essentials are:
* **Initiative with judgement:** you take a sensible first step, work out what matters and know when to decide independently or ask.
* **Conscientious follow-through:** you notice details, keep promises, communicate clearly and flag problems before they become surprises. You treat sensitive information with care.
* **A readiness to change how you work:** AI moves almost weekly. You’re willing to experiment, question your assumptions and rethink familiar approaches as you learn. Use AI actively, but check its answers and take responsibility for the result.
You’ll also need to join us for the three core London office days. Evidence can come from employment, study, volunteering, caring responsibilities or personal projects.

**Profile Summary**
This is a senior, highly technical role within the Mizuho EMEA Market Risk team, carrying independent risk oversight responsibility across cross-asset derivatives franchise in FX and IR. The position combines deep FX and FX Options coverage – spanning vanilla and exotic spectrum – with additional oversight of the Fixed Income derivatives portfolio, including interest rate swaps, inflation derivatives, structured rates products and cross-currency transactions.
Role will also act in as senior manager, ability to deputise for Head of EMEA Market Risk management on regular basis.
The successful candidate will serve as the primary market risk authority for Mizuho EMEA’s derivatives businesses, partnering closely with FX and Rates trading, structuring and quantitative analytics teams. This is a hands-on, intellectually demanding role that requires genuine quantitative depth, commercial awareness of trading dynamics and the credibility to challenge front-office pricing and hedging assumptions at the most senior level.
It is a compelling time to join Mizuho in EMEA as the bank continues to build out its Risk team and capabilities. The person will be given the required backing and support to ensure success.
**Duties and Responsibilities**
**End-to-End Market Risk Ownership – FX & FX Options**
* Closely observe relevant market developments across rates and currencies markets, critically review risks in FEG / Rates Derivatives portfolio and provide value-added challenge on risk positioning in forward looking market context.
* Manage market risk framework for the entire FX and FXO businesses, including daily risk reporting, P&L attribution, limit monitoring and escalation across spot, forwards, vanilla options and the full suite of exotic structures.
* Monitor and analyse risk sensitivities across the full FX volatility surface – delta, gamma, vega, and higher-order Greeks – with particular focus on spot vol grids, pin risks, smile dynamics, term structure and cross-currency effects.
* Understand and challenge pricing models for exotic FX options and inputs including local and stochastic volatility.
* Maintain and evolve the limit framework for FX and FXO businesses, ensuring coverage of Greeks limits, VaR, stress and notional constraints aligned to risk appetite and regulatory standards.
* Support the FRTB IMA / SA-TB analysis for derivatives trading books, contributing to internal capital calculations and regulatory submissions alongside the Head of Market Risk.
**End-to-End Market Risk Ownership – Fixed Income Derivatives**
* Provide independent daily risk oversight for the Fixed Income derivatives portfolio, including interest rate swaps (vanilla, basis, OIS, cross-currency), inflation swaps and linkers, swaptions and structured rates products, and the DRSE (Derivative Risk Solutions EMEA) interest rate and currency hedging portfolio.
* Monitor and analyse rates sensitivities across tenors, currencies and curves – including DV01, PV01, convexity, vega, cross-gamma and basis risk – ensuring a complete and accurate risk picture across the multi-currency rates franchise.
* Oversee the interaction between FX and rates risk in cross-currency derivatives ensuring coherent cross-asset risk measurement and appropriate limit coverage.
**Stress Testing & Scenario Analysis**
* Design, implement and maintain bespoke stress scenarios for the combined FX derivatives and FI derivatives portfolios, covering: FX spot and volatility surface shocks, correlation breakdown, liquidity squeezes and geopolitical events; parallel and non-parallel yield curve shifts, central bank policy surprises and sovereign spread stress; combined cross-asset scenarios that capture the interaction between FX and rates risk in structured products and cross-currency transactions.
* Ensure FRTB-compliant Expected Shortfall and SA calculations are robust, well-documented and regularly reviewed.
* Lead historical stress test analysis, mapping significant market events (GFC, Eurozone crisis, 2022 GBP/LDI event, post-COVID rate normalisation, EM FX crises) to current portfolio exposures.
* Develop reverse stress tests across the derivatives book, identifying scenarios that approach risk appetite thresholds and working with management on appropriate mitigants.
* Present stress testing methodology, results and management actions to the Stress Testing Committee, Market Model & Methodology Committee and, where required, regulatory supervisors.
**Model Governance & Risk Infrastructure**
* Act as a key contributor to the model governance process for FX and rates derivatives pricing models, providing independent market risk input to model validation and approval processes.
* Lead the development and enhancement of in-house risk analytics tools (Python-based Greeks calculators, P&L explain frameworks, scenario engines) to support real-time risk management of complex exotic and structured portfolios.
* Identify and escalate model limitations, calibration weaknesses and infrastructure gaps; drive remediation in collaboration with Quantitative Analytics and Technology.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of P&L attribution methodology across the FX and FI derivatives books, ensuring risk explain frameworks keep pace with product and model development.
**Governance & Stakeholder Engagement**
* Partner closely with FX and Rates traders, structurers and quants on new product approvals, hedging strategy reviews and limit breach management.
* Prepare and present risk positions, stress results and technical insights to senior risk management, the EMEA Risk Management Committee, Stress Testing Committee, Market Model & Methodology Committee and the New Product Working Group.
* Act as a credible and technically authoritative counterpart to FCA/PRA supervisors and internal audit on matters relating to FX derivatives and FI derivatives market risk.
* Maintain strong working relationships with Tokyo-based parent risk functions, ensuring EMEA derivatives risk is accurately and transparently represented at group level.
* Attend and contribute to the Prudential & Regulation Committee, Financing Committee and other governance forums as directed by the Head of Market Risk EMEA.
**Team Leadership & Development**
* Deputise for Head of EMEA MRM on key committees and senior leadership meetings.
* Strategical thinker with critically review existing processes and drive improvements forward.
* Mentor a small team of risk analysts, maintaining personal technical ownership of the most complex areas of the book.
* Foster a culture of rigour, intellectual curiosity and continuous improvement within the team, supporting the Head of Market Risk EMEA in developing the broader Market Risk function.
**Qualifications, Skills, and Experience**
* A minimum of eight to ten years of relevant post-qualification experience in market risk management (or a front-office quant/risk hybrid role) specifically covering FX options and/or interest rate derivatives in an investment bank, major hedge fund or large systematic trading house.
* Proven track record of independent risk ownership across vanilla FX options and a wide range of exotic structures (barriers, Asians, lookbacks, digitals, quantos, volatility products).
* Material experience covering Fixed Income derivatives risk, including multi-currency swaps, swaptions, inflation and structured rates products, ideally alongside FX derivatives coverage.
* Demonstrable experience in stress testing methodology and scenario design for derivatives portfolios, including presentation to senior risk governance forums.
* Direct exposure to regulatory frameworks including FRTB (IMA and SA-TB)
* Relevant academic background in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Physics, Financial Engineering or equivalent) from a leading institution; MSc or PhD strongly preferred. CFA, FRM or PRM is advantageous.
* Advanced understanding of option pricing theory and numerical methods.
* Strong command of FX volatility surface construction, arbitrage-free interpolation and dynamic smile modelling.
* Deep knowledge of exotic FX option risk drivers: path-dependency, barrier monitoring, averaging features, quanto adjustments and correlation skew.
* Solid technical grounding in interest rate derivatives risk measurement: multi-curve DV01/PV01, convexity, basis risk, swaption vega, cross-gamma and XCCY basis.
* Proficiency in Python for risk analytics development and P&L explain.
* Familiarity with industry risk and pricing platforms (Murex) and data infrastructure.

**ABOUT NEUTREENO**
Climate change is the defining business challenge of our time, and we're here to solve it. Most decarbonisation solutions count emissions but do nothing to reduce them. We've changed that.
We’re Neutreeno, an emissions-to-performance platform, born out of the University of Cambridge's Department of Engineering. We help companies with supply chains and production processes turn emissions data into operational insight, the kind that cuts costs, sharpens decisions, and unlocks genuine competitive advantage. For operations and finance, it's margin they can measure. For sustainability teams, it's progress they can prove. Same data, two audiences, one engine.
We’re a fast-moving team that values EQ just as much as IQ. Autonomy, high ownership, speed and no-ego collaboration are at our core. We seek people who care deeply and are eager to work on solving problems bigger than themselves.
**THE ROLE**
As a Decarbonisation Model Engineer, you'll sit at the forefront of industrial decarbonisation, identifying, evaluating and modelling the technologies and process changes that cut carbon emissions across complex industries. The role is defined by system-level thinking: treating a client's processes, sites, energy supply and supply chain as one connected system, then finding where a change in energy use, material use or technology delivers the greatest reduction in emissions and cost.
Working across sectors like jet engine production, electricity transmission and EV battery manufacturing, you'll sit at the intersection of engineering, sustainability, economics and data science. Your models become part of the product, putting a credible number on every lever: what it costs, what it returns, and what it is worth under today's and tomorrow's carbon prices.
**THE WORK YOU'LL DO**
* Build bottom-up models from first principles that calculate bespoke decarbonisation levers at scale, accounting for cost, dependencies and implementation time.
* Quantify energy and material efficiency opportunities, from heat recovery, electrification and utilities to yield losses, material substitution and circular design while identifying Best Available Technologies (BAT) for technology-specific cases.
* Develop the techno-economic analysis behind each lever: CAPEX and OPEX, cost of abatement, marginal abatement cost curves, and sensitivity analysis that stands up to a client's finance team.
* Develop our carbon pricing engine across the current pricing landscape (compliance markets, taxation, internal shadow pricing, CBAM) and model client exposure under different price scenarios.
* Identify where decarbonisation creates value, including green premium pricing for low-carbon products and access to incentives and green finance.
* Write clear, reproducible Python behind the models and mentor junior engineers.

* Masters or PhD in Industrial, Chemical, Process or Mechanical Engineering.
* 3+ years of industry or research experience in techno-economic modelling, with a strong focus on energy and material efficiency and emissions reduction.
* Proven system-level thinking: able to reason about whole systems and identify where the biggest opportunity sits, rather than optimising components in isolation.
* Deep working knowledge of energy and material efficiency in industry: heat integration, electrification and fuel switching, and how material flows, yield losses and substitution drive embodied emissions.
* Strong command of carbon accounting and life cycle assessment, including Scope 1, 2 and 3 inventories, product carbon footprints and the relevant frameworks (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064 / 14067, SBTi, CBAM).

* Expert Python for quantitative modelling (pandas, NumPy), with the discipline to make models reproducible, validated and version-controlled (Git/GitHub).
* Familiarity with using LLMs and agentic-AI workflows to build and enhance decarbonisation roadmaps.
* Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
* Experience with process simulation software (e.g. Aspen Plus, HYSYS).
* Experience building marginal abatement cost curves or decarbonisation roadmaps for large industrial clients.
* Knowledge of optimisation or machine learning applied to process optimisation and emissions reduction.

# Senior Credit Risk Analyst
**Department:** Finance **Reports to:** Head of Credit **Location:** NMBS Head Office / hybrid working as agreed **Document purpose:** This role profile sets out the core purpose, responsibilities, performance standards and personal attributes required for the Senior Credit Risk Analyst role in 2026.
## Role purpose
The Senior Credit Risk Analyst supports disciplined credit risk management across the NMBS member base, with a particular focus on higher-value credit exposures, financial statement review, credit-limit recommendations and management information. The role provides analytical insight to the Head of Credit and wider Finance team, helping NMBS make informed, timely and commercially balanced credit decisions.
In a challenging trading environment, the role is expected to strengthen NMBS’s credit control capability by enhancing the quality of risk analysis, supporting member engagement, enhancing reporting and helping the Credit Risk team work in a more efficient, consistent and proactive way.
## Key responsibilities
### Credit risk analysis and credit-limit management
* Perform detailed credit risk analysis on members to support the credit decision-making process.
* Review annual financial statements, management accounts and other financial information received from members.
* Identify financial stress indicators, trading concerns, liquidity pressures and other emerging risk signals.
* Assess member creditworthiness and provide clear recommendations to the Head of Credit on appropriate credit-limit setting.
* Take ownership of a defined portfolio of higher-value member credit limits and manage these proactively from a credit risk perspective.
* Support the Head of Credit with annual member credit reviews and ad hoc risk assessments.
* Engage with members’ finance and commercial teams where required, to obtain information, understand trading context and support effective credit review.
* Attend member meetings where appropriate to discuss financial statements, credit position and risk-related matters.
### Reporting, management information and insight
* Produce clear, accurate and timely reports relating to the management of the back-office credit risk process.
* Prepare a monthly credit risk report for the Head of Credit, highlighting key exposures, movements, risks, actions and recommendations.
* Track agreed KPIs and provide evidence-based commentary on progress, exceptions and areas requiring attention.
* Improve the quality and consistency of credit risk reporting so that outputs are useful, actionable and suitable for senior review.
* Use data and analysis to identify trends, recurring issues and opportunities for process improvement.
### Team support and process improvement
* Support Credit Risk team members by sharing knowledge, best practice and practical guidance.
* Help develop smarter, more efficient and consistent ways of working within the Credit Risk team.
* Contribute to process improvement across credit checking, member review, credit-limit monitoring and reporting.
* Bring forward ideas and initiatives that improve control, accuracy, productivity or member service.
* Assist in all areas of credit management as required, particularly during periods of increased workload or business pressure.
### Member, supplier and internal stakeholder engagement
* Maintain a professional, customer-focused approach when dealing with members, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Communicate clearly and confidently by telephone, email and in meetings.
* Build strong working relationships across Finance, Credit Risk and the wider NMBS business.
* Escalate concerns promptly and constructively, ensuring that risks are visible and understood.
* Represent the Credit Risk function professionally when engaging with members and external contacts.
### General responsibilities
* Work in line with NMBS policies, procedures and standards.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling member financial information and commercially sensitive data.
* Support the wider Finance team and Head of Credit with additional duties that are appropriate to the role and business needs.
## Performance standards
The role holder will be expected to demonstrate the following standards:
* Strong experience in credit control, credit risk management or a closely related finance discipline.
* Ability to interpret financial statements, management accounts and supporting financial information.
* Sound judgement in identifying financial stress signals and assessing the level of risk presented.
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritise effectively and meet required deadlines.
* Delivery of agreed objectives and KPIs, both individually and as part of the wider team.
* High standards of accuracy, attention to detail and consistency in analysis and reporting.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks and make well-reasoned recommendations.
* Professional communication style, including an excellent telephone manner and clear written communication.
* Willingness to travel within the UK where required for member meetings.
* Flexibility to support the business outside standard working hours where this is reasonably required.
* Openness to change, continuous improvement and constructive feedback.
## Personal attributes
The role holder should demonstrate:
* Strong analytical thinking and a structured approach to problem solving.
* Self-motivation and the ability to work proactively on their own initiative.
* A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues within a close-knit team.
* Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Confidence in building relationships with members, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* A practical, commercially aware approach to credit risk assessment.
* Professional resilience and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
* A positive attitude, with a drive to deliver high-quality work and continuous improvement.
* Commitment to personal development and keeping knowledge current.
* Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with financial data.
* CICM qualification or equivalent credit management experience, desirable.

* Leads Node4’s Network Operations Centre, acting as the Derby control tower for 24\*7 monitoring and incident response.

* Ensures proactive detection, disciplined incident management, and consistent service outcomes aligned with the practice’s service strategy.
* Works closely with Reactive Support, Network Delivery, and Architecture to reduce incident demand and improve end‐to‐end service outcomes.

* Oversee NOC monitoring and incident response to ensure timely detection and resolution of alerts. Act as the management escalation point during critical incidents, coordinating resources and communication as needed.
* Oversee NOC execution of standard, low-risk changes during out-of-hours maintenance windows. Ensure each change is backed by an approved runbook or change plan, proper change record/approvals, thorough pre-checks, live monitoring, and a clear rollback plan. Authorise go/no-go decisions for NOC-run changes on shift and escalate to on-call specialists if any deviation occurs.

Maintain strict adherence to Node4’s change management and incident management processes. # Data Science Specialist, Computational Real-World Evidence (cRWE), Data Science, London
Category: Data & AI
Location: London, London, GB
Are you passionate about turning complex real-world patient data into evidence that shapes the future of medicine? Do you thrive at the intersection of data science, human health and strategic decision-making? Join Novo Nordisk as a Data Science Specialist and help drive critical early R&D decisions by applying advanced analytics, machine learning, causal inference and AI to some of the most important questions in drug discovery and development.
**Your new role**
As a Data Science Specialist, you will be a senior individual contributor within Computational Real-World Evidence (cRWE), helping convert large-scale observational human data into decision-ready evidence that supports disease understanding, target discovery, target maturation and early development decisions.
Working across diverse scientific disciplines, you will provide both hands-on analytical leadership and strategic guidance, ensuring that scientific questions are translated into robust analytical approaches that influence portfolio and pipeline decisions.
Your key responsibilities will include:
* Leading high-priority data science projects that support preclinical and early development decision-making.
* Developing and implementing analytical and agenticAI approaches across causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning, deep learning and multimodal data analysis.
* Translating biological, clinical and portfolio questions into executable analysis plans and actionable evidence.
* Driving scientific quality, reproducibility and analytical excellence across projects, ensuring appropriate interpretation of uncertainty, bias and causality.
You will work closely with experts across research, biology, epidemiology, translational medicine, clinical development and data science to generate evidence that can meaningfully impact strategic R&D decisions.
**Your new department**
Computational Real-World Evidence (cRWE) is part of Data Science within the AI & Digital Innovation organisation. The team applies causal inference, advanced statistics, machine learning and artificial intelligence to population-level longitudinal datasets, including electronic health records, claims data, disease registries and large human cohorts.
Our work focuses on the early stages of the R&D value chain, helping scientists better understand diseases, identify patient subgroups, validate targets and strengthen the evidence required before first human dose.
You will join a highly collaborative, international team where scientific curiosity, innovation and methodological excellence are valued equally. The environment offers a unique opportunity to work on complex biomedical questions while contributing to the evolution of advanced data science and agenticAI capabilities across Novo.
**Your skills and qualifications**
To succeed in this role, you combine deep technical expertise with scientific judgement, strong communication skills and a passion for solving complex healthcare challenges.
We are looking for candidates with:
* A PhD or equivalent research experience in data science, statistics, mathematics, physics, computer science, computational biology or another quantitative discipline.
* Strong expertise in statistical modelling, machine learning, AI or a related discipline, with demonstrated ability to select and evaluate appropriate methodologies.
* Significant experience working with longitudinal patient-level datasets such as electronic health records, medical claims, registries or large human cohorts.
* Significant experience with causal inference, longitudinal modelling, clustering, survival analysis and modern AI approaches relevant to biomedical research.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or R, including experience working in cloud-based high-performance computing environments and reproducible research practices.
In addition, experience supporting drug discovery, translational research, target validation or early development within the pharmaceutical, biotech or technology sectors would be highly advantageous.
**Working at Novo**
Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. # Staff Network Engineer
Ireland; UK
# **About Nscale**
Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud strengthens technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.
At Nscale, our Engineering team plays a critical role in deploying and operating the infrastructure and software platforms that power our customers.
We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.
# **About the Role**
The Network Engineering Team is responsible for the design, validation, and ongoing operation of all networking services that underpin both the internal management platform and the customer-facing cloud infrastructure — including high-performance Ethernet fabrics, InfiniBand, WAN connectivity, and data center networking. The team also acts as a 3rd/4th line escalation point for the support organization.
As a Staff Network Engineer, you will be a technical authority for Nscale’s AI-optimized network fabrics. You will drive the technical direction across low-latency, high-bandwidth InfiniBand and Ethernet networks supporting large-scale training and inference workloads; own critical technical domains end to end; and raise the bar for architecture, automation, operational rigor, and engineering standards across the organization.
You will combine deep hands-on engineering with broad architectural influence. You’ll define reference architectures, drive consistency across sites, lead complex technical decisions and escalations, and mentor engineers while partnering closely with deployment, data center operations, platform engineering, and vendors.
# **What You'll Be Doing**
* Define, design, validate, and evolve large-scale InfiniBand/RoCE and Ethernet fabric architectures at rack, row, and data center scale, with tight integration to bare-metal provisioning and cluster management systems.
* Own technical direction for high-performance Ethernet fabrics, including BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, LACP, and QoS, and establish reference architectures and standards implemented consistently across sites.
* Design and engineer perimeter and security infrastructure — firewalls, NAT, VPN, and security policy architecture — across WAN and data center edge environments.
* Lead network automation strategy in a GitOps model, building and guiding Python/Ansible tooling for provisioning, configuration validation, and compliance, with version-controlled configuration and CI/CD-driven change across multi-vendor environments.
* Drive operational excellence by leading complex escalations and root-cause analysis for performance and stability issues, and systematically reducing reactive toil through runbooks, automation, and measurable SLOs.
* Set the direction for network observability, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting to provide clear visibility into fabric health, performance, and traffic patterns.
* Ensure the accuracy and reliability of source-of-truth network inventory and configuration data, with changes flowing through structured engineering and change-management practices.
* Partner with deployment, data center operations, platform engineering, systems, storage, and vendors on new site delivery and platform evolution.
* Act as a technical mentor and force multiplier across the team through architecture reviews, design reviews, incident leadership, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
* Identify systemic risks and architectural gaps across sites and drive durable solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and operational simplicity.
# **About You (Skills / Qualifications)**
* 10+ years of network engineering experience, with significant depth in HPC, AI, hyperscale, or large-scale data center environments.
* Extensive hands-on experience with RDMA-aware networking for AI/HPC workloads, including InfiniBand and/or RoCE, subnet managers such as OpenSM/UFM, and fabric orchestration.
* Expert-level knowledge of modern data center routing and control planes, including BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, and Clos/spine-leaf architectures, with production experience on platforms such as Cumulus, Nokia, or Arista EOS.
* Strong network automation expertise using Python and Ansible, Git-based workflows, and modern infrastructure-as-code and pipeline tooling such as Terraform, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions; you treat the network as code rather than managing devices by hand.
* Deep design and engineering experience with firewall platforms such as Juniper SRX and/or Palo Alto, including security policy architecture, high-availability design, and multi-tenant segmentation.
* Experience designing network telemetry and observability for high-throughput, performance-sensitive environments.
* Proven ability to lead complex technical decisions and incidents across networking, systems, storage, and HPC/AI workload teams, with the judgment to balance performance, reliability, operability, and delivery velocity.
* Demonstrated experience defining architecture, standards, and technical strategy beyond a single project or site, and influencing engineering teams without relying on formal authority.
* Strong communication and mentoring skills, with the ability to make complex technical trade-offs clear to engineering leaders, operators, and cross-functional partners.
* Hands-on, adaptable, and comfortable operating with high ownership in a fast-paced environment building next-generation infrastructure for ML scale-out.
# **Equal Opportunities Statement**
At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

* Decommissioning
* Waste treatment

# **Senior Research Scientist – Atomic and Optical Physics**
**Salary & Benefits:** Competitive
**Department:** Research & Development
**Reports to:** Head of Future Systems
**Job Type:** Full time
**Location:** Central London, On-site (lab-based)
**About us**
ORCA Computing (“ORCA”) is at the forefront of a new era in high-performance computing, developing full-stack photonic quantum systems designed to transform how organisations tackle machine learning, generative AI, and complex optimisation challenges. Headquartered in London, ORCA has delivered eleven on-premises quantum computers worldwide – demonstrating that its technology is not theoretical but already delivering real world results.
At the core of ORCA’s innovation is its hybrid quantum-classical architecture, engineered for seamless integration into existing AI and HPC infrastructure. Its current PT-2 system, a rack-mounted quantum computer, connects directly to GPU clusters via NVIDIA’s CUDA-Q platform, enabling accelerated AI workloads with significantly lower energy consumption than traditional silicon-based systems. Backed by a strong portfolio of patent families spanning photonic integrated circuits, quantum memory, and multiplexing technologies, ORCA is enabling enterprises, research institutions, and HPC operators to unlock new levels of performance, efficiency, and scalability.
As ORCA prepares to launch its next-generation PT-3 system, the company is entering a pivotal phase of growth and technological advancement. Its solutions are already being embedded into generative AI pipelines, delivering measurable improvements in model performance, while also addressing the rising energy demands of large-scale AI adoption. With a focus on practical deployment and a clear roadmap to fault-tolerant quantum computing, ORCA is leading the development and deployment of quantum technology, providing a commercially viable path to the future of computing.
**The role**
We are looking for a Senior Research Scientist to develop, build, and operate experimental systems underpinning ORCA’s atom-mediated nonlinear protocols for photon-photon gates. The role sits at the intersection of cold-atom physics, cavity-QED and experimental quantum optics, with a focus on integrating high-performance optical cavities into robust experimental demonstrators.
**What you will do**
* Design, build, and operate systems for trapping and delivering atomic ensembles into optical microcavities.
* Develop and optimise cavity coupling, state preparation, and locking techniques for stable and reliable atom-cavity interactions.
* Implement and characterise ORCA’s nonlinear protocols on these platforms and drive improvements towards strong photon–photon quantum gates.
* Work closely with the wider Research team to engineer the system for high performance, repeatability, and integration into ORCA’s photonic quantum computing platform.
* Contribute to experimental strategy and future research directions based on measured performance, technical risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Advance ORCA’s scientific and commercial leadership through high-quality publications, patent filings, internal reviews, and by advising stakeholders on future research directions.
**What you will bring**
* A PhD in physics or a related discipline, or equivalent research experience.
* A strong background in AMO physics and quantum optics.
* Extensive hands-on experience building and operating cold-atom experiments, including for example, laser cooling, magneto-optical traps, dipole trapping, and ultra-high-vacuum systems.
* Experience interfacing atoms with optical cavities or a closely related cavity-QED background, including cavity locking and laser frequency stabilisation.
* A track record of taking complex quantum optics or AMO experiments from design through construction to reliable, high-performance operation.
**Nice to have**
* Experience preparing high-density, high-optical-depth atomic ensembles.
* Experience with high-efficiency fibre coupling, single-photon detection, or quantum optics at the single-photon level.
* Experience developing experiment control, automation, data acquisition, or optimisation tools.
* Experience turning laboratory experiments into robust, deployable systems.
* Familiarity with photonic quantum computing.
**Who we are looking for**
* Ability to focus on results that deliver real, working systems: building for reliability and repeatability, not just one-off demonstrations.
* Can manage ambiguity: you can make progress and trade-offs even when data is incomplete or assumptions evolve.
* Cross-functional mindset: you enjoy working with theorists, engineers, and leadership to drive aligned outcomes.
* Intellectual humility: you are confident challenging assumptions, and just as open to having your own challenged.
**Why join us**
Joining ORCA Computing offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of quantum technology, where innovation is already delivering real-world impact. Across commercial, operational, and product roles, you’ll collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to bring advanced quantum systems to market and help integrate quantum capabilities into modern AI and data centre ecosystems.
ORCA provides a rare chance to contribute to a pivotal moment in the evolution of computing. With a culture built on ownership, collaboration, and ambition, the company empowers individuals to solve complex challenges and shape how next-generation quantum technologies are developed, deployed, and scaled across industries – driving a more efficient and powerful future for AI and compute.
**How to apply**
Please send your CV and a brief introduction (one paragraph is fine!) to: careers@orcacomputing.com.

**About Outreach**
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete **agentic AI** platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.
### **The Role**
The Senior Tier 3 Technical Support Engineer (TSE) is a trusted advisor to the broader Outreach Technical Support team, as well as an entry-point for back-line Technical Support delivery. This role delivers on a broad range of Tier 3 Technical Support responsibilities across the organization. The Senior Tier 3 TSE serves as a key cross-functional collaborator helping drive resolutions of our most complex technical support issues. The role partners with Technical Support Delivery, Technical Escalations Management, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product Management, and Product Engineering. The Senior Tier 3 TSE serves as a subject matter in at least one product functional area and can effectively investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve a wide variety of technical issues. This role plays a central part in our mission-critical incident management process. **Location**
While we are remote-friendly, we remain an "office-centric" company. This role is categorized as hybrid and it is expected you live in **a reasonable proximity to the office in London** so you would be able to connect with your team on weekly regular basis, attend in-person meetings and company events.
**This is a full-time, permanent role, not eligible for contractors and for work from other countries.**
### NOTE:
The offer is contingent upon successfully passing the background screening process.
### Your Daily Adventures Will Include
* Serve as the primary point of escalation for technical support issues requiring advanced troubleshooting, accurate reproduction, log analysis, and technical context
* Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one product-functional area, and be able to conduct advanced troubleshooting across the broader product functional areas
* Serve as the technical escalation point and customer advocate with Outreach’s Product Engineering team
* Regularly resolves moderately complex customer problems requiring investigation across multiple systems, logs, configurations, or workflows, applying structured analytical thinking to identify probable root causes
* Participate in the incident response rotation throughout the entire incident lifecycle, including incident detection, incident management, customer communications, and root cause analysis
* Regularly takes ownership of escalations from frontline support teams, employing methodical troubleshooting and support processes to efficiently identify, triage, and resolve customer issues
* Contribute to operational process improvements, mentor team members, and identify recurring support trends
* Deliver SME/Support Stakeholder feedback throughout product release readiness activities
* Contribute to enablement activities including KB article creation, mentoring, swarming duties
* Develop a skillset around leveraging AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, issue resolution, enablement
* Balance reactive escalation handling with proactive identification of product gaps, documentation improvements, and customer experience enhancements
* Meet or exceed most Support Scorecard metrics while contributing to support content, internal documentation, and process refinement
### Our Vision of You
**Required**
* 2–5 years of technical support or production-support experience, demonstrating increasing scope and impact in supporting customers in complex SaaS/Enterprise software environment
* Demonstrated ability to independently investigate and resolve moderately complex issues spanning multiple systems, logs, and configurations
* Demonstrated ability to learn new and evolving technologies
* Experience partnering directly with Engineering teams on defect analysis, reproduction, and root-cause investigation
* Able to work independently on most assigned responsibilities, managing day-to-day priorities with limited oversight.
* Communicates clearly and proactively with internal and external stakeholders, providing structured, accurate status updates during troubleshooting and escalations
* Demonstrates sound judgment while balancing customer expectations, technical limitations, business priorities, and operational efficiency
* Experience with log analysis/observability tools such as Clickhouse, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, etc
**Nice to Have**
* Experience supporting CRM Platforms such as Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics
* Experience with enterprise email systems & infrastructure, including troubleshooting email deliverability
* Experience with VoIP (Twilio), investigating call quality and related infrastructure and networking issues
* Experience with ticketing systems such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, JIRA
* Experience with AI tools such as Claude, Google Gemini, Atlassian ROVO, or similar
* Working knowledge of Authentication Protocols/SSO such as SAML and OAuth
* Working knowledge REST API and testing tools such as Postman
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals
* Experience participating in incident response
**Why You’ll Love It Here**
● 25 days holiday + 8 bank holidays
● Outreach contributes with monthly contribution towards your pension
● Private medical care for employee and spouse/family with Program Health Plus
● Cashplan is offered through Medicash to help offset out of pocket medical related expenses
● Dental coverage
● Life insurance at 4x annual salary

##### Job Description:
**About the client:** The company is a rapidly growing, innovative organisation focused on helping the NHS reduce its surgical backlog. Its clinicians work directly within NHS facilities, typically utilising weekends and other available operating theatre time to maximise resource use and deliver much-needed care. At the core of the company's mission is leveraging technology to make healthcare more efficient and accessible. **About the Role:** Our client is looking for a highly capable, hands-on Senior Systems Engineer to build, maintain, and continuously improve their systems, integrations, and automation workflows. This is a deeply practical role focused on designing, implementing, and troubleshooting real systems across the client's Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, and SaaS ecosystem. The successful candidate will work directly on the tools, APIs, databases, and workflows that underpin NHS and private healthcare operations, ensuring they are reliable, secure, and efficient. This is not a management or strategy-led role — the engineer must be comfortable getting into the detail, writing and debugging integrations, fixing issues quickly, and shipping working solutions. The engineer should be comfortable treating automation, data, and integrations as software — using version control, structured deployment practices, and maintainable code rather than purely UI-based tooling. **What you'll do:** **1. Systems Implementation & Maintenance**
* Configuring and maintaining the Microsoft 365 environment, including SharePoint sites, Teams, user access and Entra ID users, groups and permissions, as well as supporting Azure services such as serverless workflows, API endpoints and automation jobs.
* Taking responsibility for maintaining core infrastructure and system configurations across the business, diagnosing and resolving issues across cloud platforms and SaaS tools, and keeping the overall environment stable and well maintained.
**2. Automation, Integration & Data Workflows**
* A key part of the role will be building and maintaining automation workflows using Make.com and API integrations, as well as implementing and troubleshooting integrations with Monday.com, Airtable, NHS Digital services, AWS Lambda/ECS pipelines, Landbot and Databricks.
* You will work directly with JSON payloads, REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven systems, debugging failed runs and edge cases, improving the reliability of automation pipelines, and moving complex logic out of low-code tools into maintainable, version-controlled code where appropriate.
**3. Development Lifecycle, Version Control & Deployment**
* You will bring greater structure to the way code, scripts and configuration assets are developed and managed, using GitHub or an equivalent platform alongside proper branching strategies, pull requests and version-control best practices.
* You'll maintain clear version control across integration scripts, API clients, helper services and data-processing configurations, while helping implement environment separation, safe deployments, change tracking and lightweight CI/CD processes such as GitHub Actions, ensuring systems remain maintainable and don't rely on undocumented logic.
**4. Database Design & Data Management**
* Have a strong focus on designing and maintaining clean, scalable data structures across systems including Airtable and other databases, applying sound principles around normalisation, referential integrity and validation.
* Ensuring data models support automation, reporting and downstream processing, with the role also working across structured and semi-structured data in APIs and pipelines and supporting data flows into processing environments such as Databricks where relevant.
**5. Troubleshooting & System Reliability**
* You'll become the go-to person for technical issues across systems, integrations and data workflows, from authentication issues and data synchronisation problems to workflow failures and API errors.
* Alongside resolving issues as they arise, the role will focus on improving logging, monitoring and error handling so problems can be identified more easily and the company's systems remain reliable day to day.
**6. Security & Best Practice Implementation**
* Keeping the company's systems secure will be an important part of the role, including implementing and maintaining MFA, access controls, permissions and secure credential handling, as well as managing email authentication through SPF, DKIM and DMARC.
* You'll also support compliance requirements such as DSPT and NHS data handling from a technical implementation perspective, with an emphasis on good security hygiene across all platforms without over-engineering solutions.
**7. AI & Automation Tooling**
* The role will also involve implementing and maintaining AI-powered tools such as voice agents, internal AI assistants and transcription pipelines, working with prompts, APIs and automation tools to ensure reliable outputs. These tools will need to be continuously tested and improved based on real-world usage, with a focus on making practical improvements quickly.
**8. General Technical Support**
* Alongside the more technical development work, you'll support internal teams with system issues and process improvements and work directly with vendors such as Microsoft, AWS, Make.com, Monday.com and Airtable to resolve technical problems.
* Set up new tools, integrations and workflows as required, while keeping lightweight, practical documentation in place and prioritising working, effective systems over unnecessary process.
### Requirements

* Proven experience building and maintaining API integrations and automation workflows.

* Support month-end activities, including cut-off procedures, aged creditor reviews and the timely posting of invoices, expenses and card transactions.
* Escalate unresolved issues, process delays or control concerns to the Accounts Payable Senior.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues and recommending practical process enhancements.

* Accurate, methodical and detail-oriented.

### **The problem**
American healthcare providers spend hundreds of billions a year creating and optimizing health insurance claims. Payers spend a similar amount adjudicating them.
AI was supposed to fix this, but really it's making things worse. Providers use AI to improve claims; payers deploy AI to deny them. Both sides spend more; neither gains. So we're collapsing the middle of this negative-sum system and building the infrastructure that makes healthcare billing deterministic.
We're converting payer policies and medical notes into computable contracts grounded in formal logic - exposed via API and MCP, evaluated at the point of care, optimized for token efficiency, latency, and accuracy. # **About Plasma**
Plasma is building the primary account for global money.
Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.
Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.
Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.
The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.
## ## **The Team &** **Our Story**
We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.
We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.
## **The Context**
## The design team at Plasma is small by choice. Two senior designers currently cover the whole of Plasma One, from core money movement flows through to the design system. You would be the third.
Design is a first-class input here. It shapes product direction, technical tradeoffs, and whether people trust us with their money.
You would help decide how design actually works: how decisions get made, how work is reviewed, how quality holds up under speed, and how a coherent system takes shape as the product grows. There is no process to inherit and no large team to hide inside. What you build becomes the standard.
The team works closely with engineering and the growth team. Designers at Plasma are expected to think in systems, understand real constraints, and push for clarity where ambiguity is expensive. The bar is high, feedback is direct, and the impact is visible quickly.
This suits someone who wants autonomy and responsibility, who wants to build the product that changes how money moves, and the team behind it.
## **The Work**
* **Own the Plasma experience.** Invent new features and shape how Plasma One feels to use, taking ideas from concept to launch. Turn the advantages of stablecoins and blockchain into experiences that make people’s financial lives better.
* **Extend your abilities with AI.** Use AI as a core tool to explore more ambitious ideas, build functional prototypes, and push what you can design and deliver.
* **Bring ideas to life.** Turn abstract concepts into working coded prototypes, then collaborate with engineers who share your attention to detail to bring them into production. Refine microinteractions, motion, and visual polish together.
* **Evolve the design system.** Build reusable components and interaction patterns that keep the product coherent as it grows, with design and implementation aligned.
* **Learn from real use.** Combine research, usability testing, and product data to discover opportunities and improve what you ship.

* **Substantial consumer product experience.** Typically 6+ years in product design, including shipped native iOS and/or Android work and meaningful contributions to a design system.

* **Sound product judgment.** You can explain how user evidence changed a decision, what you chose to prioritise, and what happened after launch. You are comfortable making progress when the brief is incomplete.

* Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.
* All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

Remote, United Kingdom
Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease.
Precision for Medicine are recruiting a Regulatory Manager / Senior Regulatory Manager (depending on experience) to join our growing global team.
As a Regulatory Manager, you will provide regulatory strategy and development guidance for optimal conduct of clinical trials, regulatory agency meetings, orphan designations, paediatric planning, and accelerated procedures, ensuring timely preparation of well organised, quality regulatory submissions in compliance with applicable regulations. You will be responsible for coordinating and preparing regulatory documents for submission to Regulatory Authorities and/or Ethics Committees, as applicable. * Provides regulatory guidance throughout the clinical development life cycle
* Compile, coordinate and review applications to Regulatory Authorities including, but not limited to, CTA/IND, annual reports, routine amendments, scientific advice/regulatory authority meetings, orphan designations, paediatric planning, and marketing applications. * Develops and/or reviews documents intended for submission to the Regulatory Authorities and/or Ethics Committees to assure compliance with regulatory standards

* Bachelors degree, or equivalent experience, ideally in a scientific or healthcare discipline

**Senior Project Controls Manager – Major Capital Infrastructure Programme**
**Rolls-Royce Submarines** **Derby**
**Why join Rolls-Royce?**
At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.
By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.
**The Role**
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a **Senior Project Controls Manager** to join the Rolls-Royce Submarines Major Infrastructure Programme
The Programme is delivering a significant portfolio of complex infrastructure projects that will enable the future capability of the Submarines business. Effective Project Controls is fundamental to providing the transparency, insight and confidence required to successfully deliver this investment.
As Senior Project Controls Manager, you will be the functional authority for Project Controls, owning the Project Controls framework, standards, processes and expectations to be applied consistently across our Major Projects.
Project Controls Managers are embedded within individual Major Projects and work directly with their respective project leadership teams. Your role will provide functional leadership across this community, setting clear expectations for what good Project Controls looks like, assuring its effective application and developing capability across the programme.
Working as a senior member of the Programme Team, you will bring together information from across the Major Projects to provide the Senior Leadership Team with independent, forward-looking insight into programme performance. You will ensure Project Controls goes beyond reporting what has happened, identifying trends, emerging risks, dependencies and potential interventions to support effective leadership decision-making.
This is an influential senior leadership role requiring strong Project Controls expertise, sound judgement and the credibility to constructively challenge Major Project leadership while building a collaborative and high-performing Project Controls community.
**Key Accountabilities**
* Act as the functional authority for Project Controls across the Major Capital Infrastructure Programme, owning and continuously improving the Project Controls framework, standards, processes and ways of working
* Set clear expectations for Project Controls Managers embedded within the Major Projects, ensuring consistent and proportionate application of controls across the programme while recognising the differing scale, complexity and delivery phase of individual projects
* Define and oversee an integrated approach to planning and scheduling, cost management, risk and opportunity, change control, forecasting, Earned Value Management, performance measurement and reporting
* Ensure Major Projects establish and maintain robust and integrated performance baselines across scope, schedule and cost, providing a credible basis for measuring progress, understanding variance and forecasting outcomes
* Provide functional leadership, coaching and professional development to the Project Controls community, building capability and creating an environment in which knowledge, experience and best practice are shared across projects
* Establish an effective assurance framework for Project Controls, undertaking and commissioning maturity assessments, health checks and targeted reviews to provide confidence that controls are operating effectively
* Provide constructive challenge where Project Controls standards or project performance fall below expectations, working with Project leadership and embedded Project Controls Managers to agree and drive appropriate improvement actions
* Integrate and interpret controls information from across the Major Projects to provide the Senior Leadership Team with clear, evidence-based and forward-looking insight into programme performance
* Identify cross-programme trends, systemic issues, dependencies, emerging risks and opportunities, ensuring these are understood and appropriately escalated to enable timely leadership intervention
* Establish reporting and performance-management requirements that provide a consistent and reliable view of project and programme health, ensuring management information focuses on insight and decision support rather than simply reporting historic performance
* Ensure appropriate use of Earned Value Management, critical path analysis, forecasting, trend analysis and scenario assessment to understand current performance and likely future outcomes
* Work closely with Project Directors, Project Managers and senior leaders across Engineering, Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Risk and other functions to ensure Project Controls information is integrated into project and programme decision-making
* Ensure Project Controls processes effectively support projects delivered within NEC contractual environments, including the integration of schedule, cost, risk, change and forecasting information required to support effective contract and commercial management
* Work collaboratively with Commercial and Project teams to ensure changes and emerging issues are identified, assessed and reflected appropriately within project controls, forecasts and performance baselines.
* Drive continuous improvement in Project Controls processes, systems, data and capability, using internal and external best practice to increase maturity and effectiveness
* Support Project Controls resource and capability planning, identifying current and future capability requirements and working with Major Projects to ensure appropriate controls capability is deployed
* Represent Project Controls within appropriate governance and leadership forums, providing specialist advice, insight and challenge to support successful programme delivery
**Key Experiences and Qualifications**
To be successful in this role, you will have:
* Significant Project Controls leadership experience gained within large, complex capital projects, programmes or portfolios, ideally within infrastructure, nuclear, defence, engineering or another highly regulated environment
* Extensive knowledge and practical experience across integrated Project Controls, including planning and scheduling, cost management, risk and opportunity management, change control, forecasting, performance measurement and reporting
* Strong practical understanding of Earned Value Management, integrated performance baselines, critical path analysis, schedule and cost forecasting, trend analysis and performance measurement
* Demonstrable experience of establishing, implementing and improving Project Controls frameworks, standards, governance and ways of working across multiple projects
* Strong knowledge and practical understanding of NEC contracts and the implications of NEC delivery models for Project Controls, including programme management, change control, forecasting, risk and the provision of robust performance evidence
* Experience providing independent assurance and constructive challenge to major projects and senior project leadership teams
* The ability to interpret complex project and programme information and turn it into clear, concise and actionable insight for senior leaders, identifying not only current performance but emerging trends and likely future outcomes
* Strong leadership and influencing skills, with the credibility to set expectations and drive consistent standards across teams where you do not have direct line-management accountability
* Experience coaching, mentoring and developing Project Controls professionals and building capability across a project or programme environment
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to operate confidently with Project Directors, senior functional leaders and the Senior Leadership Team
* Strong commercial and financial awareness and an understanding of the relationship between Project Controls, commercial management and successful capital-project delivery
* Experience operating effectively within complex matrix organisations and across multidisciplinary teams
* A continuous-improvement mindset, with evidence of improving Project Controls maturity, processes, systems or capability within a complex delivery environment
* Relevant professional qualification or membership, such as APM or equivalent, would be advantageou
**The Impact You Will Have**
This role provides an opportunity to shape Project Controls across one of Rolls-Royce Submarines' most significant programmes.
You will create the standards and environment that enable Project Controls Managers across the Major Projects to succeed, while providing programme leadership with confidence in the information used to make critical decisions.
Your success will be demonstrated through consistent and mature controls across the projects, credible forecasts, effective management of change, earlier identification of emerging issues and high-quality insight that enables the Senior Leadership Team and Major Projects to make informed decisions and improve delivery outcomes.

# Director of Regulatory Strategy and Affairs
**Location:** Hull **Working pattern:** Hybrid, with a minimum of two days per week in our Hull office **Salary:** £67,000–£80,000 per annum, depending on experience and breadth of regulatory expertise **Employment type:** Full-time, permanent **Reports to:** CEO
**About Rubicon**
Rubicon is a specialist regulatory consultancy helping ambitious businesses bring products to market safely, efficiently and with confidence.
Our team supports brands, retailers, manufacturers and marketplaces across a range of regulated product categories, including food supplements, medicines, medical devices and cosmetics.
We work alongside our sister company, Rubicon Bridge, which provides regulatory technology and automated compliance solutions. Together, we combine deep technical expertise with innovative software to help businesses navigate complex regulations and trade internationally.
We are now looking for an experienced and commercially minded Director of Regulatory Affairs to lead Rubicon Technical and its multidisciplinary team of regulatory experts.
**The role**
This is a senior leadership role with responsibility for the performance and continued development of Rubicon Technical’s regulatory services.
You will lead a team of specialists working across food supplements, medicines, medical devices and cosmetics, ensuring that our advice is accurate, practical, commercially relevant and delivered consistently.
The role requires someone who combines strong regulatory expertise with excellent leadership, customer management and commercial judgement.
You will work closely with the CEO, senior leadership team and Rubicon Bridge product teams to shape our regulatory strategy, develop new services and ensure that our technical expertise continues to meet the evolving needs of our customers.
**Key responsibilities**
**Lead our regulatory team**
\* Lead, manage and develop a multidisciplinary team of regulatory experts.
\* Create a high-performing and collaborative culture with clear standards, responsibilities and expectations.
\* Support team members with complex regulatory matters and provide appropriate technical oversight.
\* Identify training, recruitment and resource requirements as the business develops.
\* Ensure workloads are managed effectively and customer projects are delivered on time.
\* Build strong working relationships across Rubicon Technical and Rubicon Bridge.
**Maintain regulatory excellence**
\* Take overall responsibility for the accuracy and consistency of regulatory advice delivered by Rubicon Technical.
\* Establish and maintain robust technical review and governance processes.
\* Ensure advice is evidence-based, clearly communicated and appropriate for each customer’s commercial objectives.
\* Provide senior-level guidance on complex, sensitive or high-risk regulatory issues.
\* Ensure the team remains informed about relevant legislative, regulatory and industry developments.
\* Maintain clear standards for documentation, technical decisions and regulatory governance.
**Support customers**
\* Act as a trusted senior regulatory adviser to key customers.
\* Build strong, long-term relationships with brands, retailers, manufacturers, marketplaces and strategic partners.
\* Translate complex regulatory requirements into clear and practical actions.
\* Support customers entering new markets, launching new products or responding to regulatory challenges.
\* Participate in important customer meetings, pitches and project reviews.
\* Ensure customers receive responsive, commercially useful and technically reliable support.
**Develop the business**
\* Work with the commercial team to shape proposals, scopes of work and regulatory service packages.
\* Support the growth of existing customer accounts and identify opportunities for additional services.
\* Help develop new propositions in response to changing regulation, customer needs and market opportunities.
\* Ensure projects are appropriately scoped, resourced and priced.
\* Take responsibility for the efficient and commercially effective operation of the regulatory function.
\* Contribute to revenue growth, customer retention and the long-term development of Rubicon Technical.
**Connect expertise with technology**
\* Work closely with Rubicon Bridge’s product and technology teams to translate regulatory expertise into scalable software solutions.
\* Help identify areas where regulatory processes can be standardised, automated or supported by technology.
\* Ensure regulatory content and methodologies embedded within the Rubicon Bridge platform remain accurate, practical and robust.
\* Contribute to the future development of regulatory products, databases and automated compliance tools.
\* Help ensure that technology strengthens the consistency, reliability and commercial value of regulatory decision-making.
**About you**
You will be an experienced regulatory leader with the credibility to manage senior specialists, advise complex customers and represent Rubicon Technical externally.
You may have developed your career within a regulatory consultancy, consumer products business, pharmaceutical or medical device company, retailer, manufacturer or regulatory authority.
You will bring:
\* Significant experience in regulatory affairs within one or more of our core categories.
\* Strong working knowledge of UK and European regulatory frameworks.
\* Experience leading and developing regulatory, scientific or technical teams.
\* The ability to oversee specialists working outside your own principal area of expertise.
\* Experience managing complex customer projects and senior stakeholder relationships.
\* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how to deliver professional services profitably.
\* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
\* The confidence to challenge, make decisions and provide clear direction.
\* A practical, solutions-focused approach to regulation.
\* The ability to operate effectively within a fast-moving and entrepreneurial business.
\* The ability to work from our Hull office for a minimum of two days each week.
Experience across several of the following areas would be particularly valuable:
\* Food supplements and nutrition.
\* Medicines and borderline products.
\* Medical devices.
\* Cosmetics and personal care.
\* Product classification and market access.
\* Claims, labelling and advertising.
\* International product registrations and notifications.
\* Regulatory due diligence.
\* Regulatory governance.
\* Regulatory technology or digital compliance solutions.
**What we are looking for**
We are not looking for someone who simply identifies regulatory obstacles.
We want a leader who can help customers understand what is possible, make informed decisions and find a compliant route to market.
You will be intellectually curious, calm under pressure and comfortable working across different product categories. You will care deeply about regulatory accuracy while also understanding that advice must be clear, responsive and commercially useful.
You will also be confident working with senior customers, supporting commercial conversations and helping the business build services that are technically robust and commercially sustainable.
Most importantly, you will be excited by the opportunity to lead an exceptional team and help shape the future of a business combining human regulatory expertise with innovative technology.
**Why join Rubicon?**
This is an opportunity to take a central leadership role within a business working at the forefront of regulatory services and technology.
You will have the opportunity to:
\* Lead a talented and highly experienced regulatory team.
\* Work with innovative brands, global retailers and international marketplaces.
\* Shape the future direction of Rubicon Technical.
\* Influence the development of regulatory technology used by businesses around the world.
\* Build new services and capabilities across multiple regulated sectors.
\* Work closely with the senior leadership team and have a genuine impact on the future of the business.
\* Join an ambitious and entrepreneurial company with a clear mission: to make global regulatory compliance simpler, faster and more accessible.

Runa is pioneering a first-of-its-kind payment rail that enables the seamless, global money movement at scale. Runa transforms this landscape by providing a new digital payments infrastructure that empowers businesses to send digital money instantly and cost-free to anyone, anywhere. Your primary focus will be **training and enablement** - helping our clients understand SchemeServe, become confident using the platform and learn how to build and manage their own insurance products.
Alongside training, you’ll work on **building and configuring insurance products for our clients** using SchemeServe. This gives you practical, hands-on experience of the platform and the same product-building processes that you'll be teaching to customers.
The balance will flex depending on demand. Some weeks may be heavily focused on client training, while others may involve more time working on client product builds more independently.
This is a varied role for someone who enjoys **technology, problem-solving and working with people**.

* Deliver engaging client training sessions covering SchemeServe and its functionality.
* Train customers to build and manage their own insurance products using SchemeServe.

* Deliver internal training and support the onboarding of SchemeServe employees.
* Create and maintain Help Guides, training videos, tutorials and other learning resources.
* Organise and host webinars covering SchemeServe functionality and best practice.
* Identify recurring knowledge gaps and turn them into useful training or self-service resources.
* Help clients become increasingly **self-sufficient** when using SchemeServe.

Alongside training, you'll work on client projects to help build and configure insurance products on SchemeServe.
This could include:
* Building new insurance products on SchemeServe.
* Translating underwriting guides and product specifications into working products.
* Configuring question sets, rules, documents and other product functionality.

* Supporting changes and updates to existing products.
