One day you might be:
* Delivering training to a broker learning how to build their first insurance product.
* Creating a new Help Guide or training video.
* Running a webinar for SchemeServe customers.
Another day you might be:
* Reviewing an underwriting guide for a new product.
* Building a question set or rating file.
* Testing a product before launch.
* Working with colleagues on a client product build.
The two areas naturally complement each other. **Building products gives you first-hand experience of the challenges our clients encounter, while training clients gives you insight into how we can make SchemeServe and our product-building processes easier to understand.**

* **Enjoy working with people** - you're comfortable explaining things and helping someone work through a problem.
* **Have insurance knowledge** - you understand insurance terminology, products and how the industry operates.
* **Enjoy teaching and sharing knowledge** - you get satisfaction from helping someone understand something new.
* **Are naturally curious** - you want to understand how things work and why.
* **Enjoy problem-solving** - you'd rather investigate and find a solution than simply follow a checklist.
* **Are comfortable with technology** - you don't need to be a developer, but you're confident learning and using digital tools.
* **Can communicate clearly** - whether you're running a training session, talking to a client or writing a Help Guide.
* **Are self-motivated and dependable** - you're comfortable managing your own workload in a remote environment.
* **Work swiftly while maintaining attention to detail.**
* **Are willing to challenge the norm** and suggest better ways of doing things.

* Experience in training (preferably in SaaS or insurance).
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Comfortable working directly with clients.
* Good general computer skills, including confidence using **Excel**.
* An interest in learning how insurance products are configured and built.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating across different teams.

* Previous experience delivering training, onboarding or demonstrations.
* Experience using insurance software or SaaS platforms.
* Experience configuring insurance products, schemes or rating.
* Experience as an underwriter, broker, configuration analyst or business/systems analyst.
* Experience creating training materials, videos or documentation.

At its heart, SchemeServe is all about **making insurance simple**.
Our platform helps insurance brokers, MGAs and insurers design, build and manage their own insurance products (or ‘schemes’) with ease. Some of our customers build their products themselves, while others ask our team to build them.

Founded in 2020 and led by ex-Deliveroo MD Dan Warne, Sessions has grown 7x in three years. Our platform has processed over 5 million orders and reaches 60% of the UK population. Our team brings experience from Deliveroo, Amazon, BrewDog, and Gousto.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
As our **New Brands Operations Manager,** you’ll own the process that decides which brands earn a permanent place in the Sessions network — the single biggest point of leverage in how well New Brands scales.
The team is in growth mode, aiming to increase the volume of brands we work with from 12 a year to 20. As volume increases, the key skill is understanding trade-offs — knowing where to spend time versus not, and what to prioritise.
You’ll work cross-functionally across Studio, Supply Chain and Growth, making sure we’re working towards outcomes rather than just tasks. * Build and maintain strong relationships with Brand Founders as well as delivery platforms.

* Maintain live visibility of the validation pipeline, so issues within any brand's validation are caught and diagnosed quickly rather than surfacing late.
**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
* Work and collaborate with Studio, Supply Chain and Growth so validation's needs are reflected in their planning.
* Understand constraints and capacity within each team, and where resource is best spent and which brands are prioritised.

## Strong modern Kotlin and Jetpack Compose experience? Join Snappy and help build and evolve the Android apps powering thousands of convenience stores and their customers across the UK
**About Us** Snappy Shopper is the UK’s fastest‐growing quick commerce (Q‐commerce) platform powering rapid grocery delivery from local convenience stores. We enable independent retailers and major partners, including SPAR, Nisa, Premier, Co‐op and others, to digitally transform their business by offering same‐day and rapid delivery of food, drink and everyday essentials within as little as 30‐60 minutes. Customers on our platform typically spend significantly more online than in‐store, helping retailers grow revenue and deepen community engagement.
We’re more than a delivery app, we’re a technology partner for local high streets, providing tools for digital sales, marketing solutions, and integrations that help retailers compete with larger online players.
At Snappy Shopper, we’re committed to innovation, retail empowerment and community impact, helping stores thrive digitally, offering exceptional local convenience to customers, and shaping the future of on‐demand retail in the UK.
**Our location** We are a UK company with colleagues across the country and offices in Dundee and Edinburgh. This is a fully remote role, with occasional opportunities to connect with colleagues in person.
**About the team** You'll join our Android team, working closely with Product, Engineering and customer-facing colleagues across the business.
Our Android estate is broader than a single consumer app.
Snappy Shopper is our consumer ordering app, built in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, Coroutines and Flow.
Order Manager receives orders in-store and supports picking, substitutions, refunds, receipt printing and driver assignment.
Snappy Pickeris used by store and warehouse teams to scan and pick products and manage gaps and substitutions.
Order Manager and Snappy Picker also mean working with older Kotlin, RxJava2 and XML codebases running on rugged hardware in thousands of stores, often over patchy connectivity and in sessions lasting all day. Here, reliability matters more than pixel polish.
**About the role**
As an experienced Android Developer, you’ll combine strong hands-on Android development with the independent technical judgement and ownership.
Day-to-day, you will:
* Design, build and maintain Android features across Snappy Shopper, Order Manager and Snappy Picker.
* Work with other Android developers and wider stakeholders to turn business requirements into clear technical approaches and deliverables.
* Make sound technical decisions, considering architecture, reliability, maintainability and the wider impact of your implementation.
* Take ownership of the quality and completeness of your solutions before they reach review.
* Review other developers’ code and contribute constructively to technical discussions.
* Troubleshoot existing Kotlin and legacy Java code and help resolve complex production issues.
* Work pragmatically, recognising when something needs solving properly now and when improvement is better left for another day.
**To be successful, you'll have:**
We’re looking for someone with strong level of Android capability rather than a checklist of every technology we use.
You’ll bring strong modern Kotlin experience, including reviewing other developers’ Kotlin and contributing meaningfully to PR discussions.
You’ll also have:
* Production experience with Jetpack Compose.
* Strong experience with Coroutines and Flow.
* Hilt, Dagger 2 or Koin experience, with a good understanding of dependency scoping.
* Experience working with multi-module Clean Architecture, where architecture and code-quality standards are enforced through tooling and CI.
* A strong unit-testing habit, using technologies such as JUnit and MockK/Mockito.
* Experience with collaborative development, version control and code review.
* Experience working within an Agile/Scrum environment.
Our apps currently ship at minSdk 24–26 and targetSdk 35–36.
We’d also like you to have done at least one of these:
* Worked with RxJava2, including good disposal discipline.
* Shipped a hardware integration using a vendor SDK, AIDL service, Bluetooth device or partner-app Intent.
* Shipped realtime functionality using WebSockets, including fallback and dead-connection handling.
* Worked with custom Dagger scopes or subcomponents with explicit teardown.
Exposure to XML/ViewBinding, Room, Crashlytics, payment SDKs, Firebase Remote Config, WorkManager, Bluetooth printing or similar technologies is useful, but isn't essential.
And there are things we don't expect you to know before you arrive. You'll learn our store domain and the hardware behind it, including Sunmi POS devices and scanners, PayPoint terminals, Zebra scanners and Bluetooth label printers.
**Who you are**
* **Community:** You collaborate well, share knowledge and help others reach better technical solutions.
* **Be Snappy:** You work at pace, adapt to changing priorities and take ownership of delivery.
* **Breaking Barriers:** You use sound technical judgement to solve difficult problems and aren't afraid to constructively challenge an approach when there's a better one.
* **Craic on:** You communicate clearly, build trusted relationships and enjoy working with technical and non-technical colleagues.
**What’s in it for you**
Joining Snappy as an Android Developer means working on more than another consumer mobile app.
You'll work across modern Compose development and established applications that sit at the heart of day-to-day store operations. You'll encounter interesting challenges around reliability, hardware, payments, realtime communication and applications operating in imperfect real-world conditions.
You'll have autonomy in how you solve problems, the opportunity to influence our Android engineering approach and a team that values good judgement as much as technical knowledge.
We offer a competitive salary, flexible remote working and ongoing opportunities for learning and development.

We want our recruitment process to give you (and us) a proper opportunity to understand whether the role is the right fit.
Following an initial application review, selected candidates will have an introductory conversation with our Engineering team to discuss your experience, the role and Snappy's Android environment.
Candidates progressing from there will take part in practical technical sessions involving different Android development scenarios and live coding exercises, giving us the opportunity to understand how you approach problems, write and work with code, make technical decisions and respond as requirements or constraints evolve.
We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to inclusive recruitment.
Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we’re only able to contact candidates who are selected to progress to the next stage.

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.
## Role Overview:
We are seeking a Senior Director to lead our Enterprise Reporting and Analytics Engineering organization, a team of analytics engineers, report developers, visualization specialists, and people leaders. This organization focuses on the last mile of the enterprise data supply chain: the semantic models, curated data products, metric definitions, and consumption experiences that turn engineered data into decisions.
This is not a traditional reporting leadership role; the classic notion of “reporting” in the form of a myriad of dashboards and filters is racing towards obsolescence. But the need for data and insights, and the need to deliver it in a way that is digestible and actionable, is timeless. Yes, governed dashboards and trusted reporting remain the foundation, and this leader must be excellent at that foundation. But the mandate is to move the organization decisively beyond static reporting toward a proactive, intelligent analytics capability: partnering with Data Science to productize and visualize their models, enabling generative AI and LLM-based access to our data, building exception-based systems that alert users when outcomes deviate from expectation in a statistically meaningful way, and designing agents that monitor data continuously and deliver insight without being asked.
Analytics engineering shares much of its DNA with data engineering — modeling, transformation, testing, version control, CI/CD, performance and cost discipline — but is oriented toward business enablement rather than platform and pipeline. Success in this role therefore depends as much on partnership as on technical depth. This leader will work shoulder to shoulder with Data Engineering on the boundary between platform and consumption, with Product Management on roadmap and requirements, with Data Science on advanced analytic products, and with Analytics Operations on a disciplined intake and prioritization process that makes the best possible use of finite capacity.
The ideal candidate has spent years building the traditional foundations — governance, metadata, lineage, dimensional modeling, engaging with enterprise BI platforms— and is now looking to apply that rigor to a fundamentally different generation of analytic products in new and innovative ways.
**What you'll be doing:**
**Organizational Leadership**
* Lead, coach, and develop an organization of approximately 30 people, including managing through frontline managers; own hiring, role clarity, career pathing, performance management, and succession planning.
* Define a multi-year vision and roadmap for enterprise reporting and analytics engineering, and translate it into quarterly outcomes the team and its partners can measure. Partner closely with Product Management to jointly shape the multi-year enterprise end-to-end data strategy.
* Own the organization's budget, vendor relationships, and contractor or offshore capacity.
* Establish and sustain an engineering culture within an analytics function: peer review, automated testing, documentation standards, source control, CI/CD, etc.
**Analytics Engineering and Data Architecture**
* Drive maturity of the last-mile architecture in partnership with Data Engineering: curated marts, semantic layers, reusable data products, and certified datasets that serve reporting, ai enablement, data science, and downstream applications.
* Define and enforce dimensional modeling standards, transformation frameworks, and modular, tested, version-controlled analytics code.
* Own the enterprise metric layer so that key business measures carry a single, governed definition regardless of where they are consumed.
* Partner with Data Engineering to define clear contracts and handoffs between pipeline and platform work and last-mile modeling, including shared tooling, standards, and escalation paths.
* Manage query performance, warehouse consumption, and platform cost as first-class engineering concerns.
**Data Governance, Metadata, and Lineage**
* Own cataloging, business glossary, data certification, and stewardship workflows, leveraging tools such as Atlan as the primary metadata platform.
* Maintain column-level lineage across the analytics estate to support impact analysis, change management, audit, and root-cause investigation.
* Leverage data access provisioning and entitlement models, including row- and column-level security, in partnership with Security, Privacy, and Compliance.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering to drive data quality monitoring, freshness and availability SLAs, observability, and incident response for analytic assets.
**Enterprise Reporting and Data Visualization**
* Drive analytics engagement by leveraging enterprise visualization and provisioning platforms, including Domo and Tableau, in partnership with Data Engineering. Ensure best practices are followed in data architecture, governance, adoption, performance, and total cost management.
* Set visualization and information design standards that make reports readable, consistent, accessible, and decision-oriented.
* Rationalize the existing reporting portfolio: retire redundant and unused assets, consolidate overlapping content, drive down tech debt and drive consumption toward certified sources.
* Build a durable self-service capability through training, templates, community, office hours, and clear guardrails on what belongs in self-service versus centrally managed content.
**Advanced, Proactive, and AI-Enabled Analytics**
* Partner with Data Science to productize their work: build the visualization, interaction, monitoring, and feedback loops that turn models and research into products the business actually uses.
* Partner with Product Management and Data Engineering to enable generative AI and LLM access to enterprise data. This includes preparing the semantic and metadata foundation that makes data legible to models, delivering conversational analytics, text-to-SQL, and retrieval-augmented experiences on governed sources, and establishing guardrails, evaluation, and accuracy monitoring so that answers can be trusted.
* Build exception-based analytics that detect when an outcome deviates from its expected value in a statistically significant way, using seasonality-aware baselines, forecast residuals, control limits, and anomaly detection rather than static thresholds.
* Route those exceptions to accountable owners with context, likely drivers, and a recommended next action; actively tune sensitivity and volume to prevent alert fatigue and preserve signal.
* Design and deploy analytic agents that proactively monitor data, investigate variances, assemble narrative explanations, and deliver insight into the tools where people already work.
* Shift the organization's consumption model from pull to push: the measure of success is not how many people opened a dashboard, but whether the right person was told the right thing at the right time.
**Cross-Functional Partnership, Intake, and Prioritization**
* Operate as a true partner to Product Management: contribute to roadmap, requirements, user research, and release planning, and run analytics with a product mindset covering personas, adoption metrics, and asset lifecycle management.
* Partner with Analytics Operations to run a transparent intake, triage, sizing, and prioritization process, with published capacity, explicit tradeoffs, and reliable delivery commitments.
* Make capacity constraints visible to stakeholders and executives, drive reuse over one-off builds, and decline or defer work with evidence rather than friction.

job_title: Software Engineer, Platform - London, United Kingdom London, United Kingdom
job_description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.
**Overview**
The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.
These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.
The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.
**What Yo****u’****ll Do**
* Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API
* Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break
* Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on
* Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for
* Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat
* Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us
* Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going
**An Ideal Candidate Should Have**
* Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)
* Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud
* A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created
* A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone
* The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it
* Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it
* A preference for being corrected over being right
* Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments
* Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes
**Interview process**
Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.
The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.
**What We Offer**
* A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
* A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
* Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
* The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
* Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
* The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
* An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

# Head of Engineering
# Lead engineering that powers how thousands of finance teams spend
Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform trusted by thousands of finance teams across Europe. As our **Head of Engineering**, you'll lead a complete engineering group — several Engineering Managers, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers — reporting directly to our CTO. You'll set the technical and organisational direction for your area, build the leadership team that runs it, and be accountable for the economics, reliability, and pace of everything it ships.
You will work with 2 to 4 Engineering Managers, reporting directly to you. You will collaborate with the Head of Product and the Head of Design, and other Head of Engineering responsible for other groups.
Your will be responsible for a multi-disciplinary engineering team of 20-30 people, with different seniority and skillset, spread across Europe.
## What you'll own
**Technical & organisational strategy**
* Define the multi-quarter technical and organisational strategy for your group, aligned with Spendesk's company strategy.
* Drive architectural decisions and simplification across your domain — clear domain boundaries, “platformisation”, debt reduction.
* Make build vs. buy vs. partner calls, and own your group's AI/tooling strategy: what to standardise, what to pilot, and how you measure impact.
* Own your area's economics — cost-to-serve, infra efficiency, hiring ROI — with a clear quarterly view, and present the commercial rationale behind your investment decisions.
**Delivery & operations**
* Be accountable for delivery and outcomes across your full portfolio of squads, balancing competing priorities without losing sight of quality.
* Establish group-level KPIs, SLOs, and operating rhythms so your teams run well without you in every room.
* Champion end-to-end observability, sensible on-call, and postmortems that actually change things — reducing incident frequency and MTTR over time.
* Sequence hiring and headcount to maximise impact, and defend that plan to stakeholders with data.
**Building your leadership team**
* Hire, develop, and retain a strong, balanced leadership team of EMs, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers.
* Coach your managers through their hardest calls: performance conversations, hiring decisions, prioritisation trade-offs.
* Lead performance calibration for your group and make the final call on promotions and compensation.
* Build succession plans for your key leadership roles, so no single departure puts your group at risk.
* Actively invest in retaining your best people, and keep a genuine pulse on team sentiment.
**Influence beyond your team**
* Represent Engineering in company-wide forums, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and customer-facing teams.
* Communicate your strategy and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and executives — you're as comfortable defending a roadmap to the leadership team as you are challenging an incident response plan.
* Champion diversity and inclusion in how you hire, develop, and run your organisation.
## What you'll bring
* 8+ years in software engineering with increasing scope, including 3+ years managing managers (Team Leads/EMs).
* A track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder programmes in product-led SaaS on time, on budget, with measurable results. Fintech, payments, or compliance experience is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience operating distributed systems at scale in production, and enough technical depth to earn credibility with ICs and Team Leads, not just manage around them.

* Real business acumen: you can talk unit economics, ROI, and trade-offs as fluently as you talk architecture.
* A genuine track record of growing managers into better managers, not just engineers into better engineers.
# Why his role, why now
You'll join at a moment where the group you lead has room to simplify, room to invest in AI-augmented engineering, and a leadership team worth building further. You'll have a documented path behind you and ahead of you: Spendesk's Engineering Leadership Growth Journey maps the road from Engineering Manager through Head of Engineering to CTO, so you'll know exactly what's expected of you, and what growing further looks like once you're here.
You'll be based in one of our offices (Paris, London or Barcelona), with a flexible on-site rhythm agreed with your team.
As we are an international team, please submit your application and CV in English.

Challenge design decisions where there are significant cost, availability, capacity, lifecycle or supplier risks.

Ensure procurement and supply chain considerations are embedded into engineering decisions rather than addressed once the design is complete.
Support Design Reviews, Technical Reviews and New Product Introduction activities.
Establish early supplier engagement where specialist technology or manufacturing capability is required.

Experience in strategic procurement, commodity management, sourcing or supply chain within a technical manufacturing environment.
Experience working directly with Engineering or technical teams.
Strong understanding of supplier manufacturing capabilities and supply chain risks.
Experience across one or more of electronics, mechanical, materials, powertrain or vision systems.
Experience engaging suppliers during product development.
A strong understanding of manufacturing processes and their impact on cost and supply.

We are not just a fintech company. We develop people by giving them the autonomy and the responsibility to challenge the status quo, so they can be the main actors of the change we want to bring to the market.

Our sales agents are on the front lines, talking to merchants every day. Across the go to market systems they use to manage their sales, HubSpot CRM is where their deals, activities, conversations, reporting, automations and portfolio lives. When HubSpot works, our salespeople sell. When it breaks quietly in the background, deals stall, data drifts, and the people who trust the numbers stop trusting the tool.
**Your mission is to be the guardian of that system.** You are the person who keeps HubSpot healthy, honest, and trustworthy, so that every seller and every leader can rely on it without ever thinking about it.
This is not a caretaking job where you wait for tickets and tick them off. You are a detective and a builder. You go looking for what is wrong before anyone reports it, you find the real reason something failed instead of patching the symptom, and you make sure the same failure never happens twice. You turn a messy, growing CRM into a system people can trust, and you can prove it with data.

**Prevent the next bug before it happens.** You do not just close errors, you learn from them. You spot the patterns, harden the implementations that keep breaking, and put guardrails in place so a whole class of problems disappears. Every automation and implementation, local or global, follows our guidelines because you make sure it does, before and after it goes live.
**Measure the health of the CRM.** You build the dashboards that show, at a glance, whether what we ship actually works and keeps working. You track error rates, adoption, and data quality over time, so CRM health stops being a feeling and becomes a number we can watch and improve.
**Turn data into action.** You are as comfortable reading the numbers as fixing the system. You globalise and clean up our reporting once the requirements from Commercial Excellence are aligned, retire the dashboards no one needs, and use data to find the problems no one has noticed yet.
**Build and improve, hands on.** You create new automations and refine the ones we have, you read the logic of a workflow well enough to debug it, and you keep the instance clean, governed, and scalable across every market in Europe.
Your goal is to maximise the value and the trust in the CRM our salespeople rely on. Your success is measured in the health of the platform: fewer recurring failures, faster time to a real fix, cleaner data, and leaders who believe the numbers again because someone is watching them every day.
## **What is your story?**
You need to be eager to learn and improve every day. Some qualities you must have:
* A detective's instinct: you are not satisfied with a symptom, you want the root cause, and you enjoy the hunt
* An owner's mindset: you do not wait to be told, you know the instance and you act on it
* Reactive when it counts and proactive by default: when something breaks you are on it and you meet the SLA, and when you see a risk you raise it before it spreads

* Experience with a CRM (HubSpot ideal, Salesforce or similar is welcome), with ticketing and SLAs, and comfort building automations and reading the logic behind them

* Ensure required evidence is collected and maintained for architecture, solution design, technical build, test readiness, deployment and hypercare.

* Identify gaps in readiness evidence and drive follow-up actions to closure.
* Help ensure workstream deliverables are audit-ready and aligned to programme governance expectations.

* Highly organised, proactive and comfortable operating across multiple technical and solution workstreams.
* Strong bias for action, follow-up and issue resolution.

The Audiology Associate will support the delivery of Audiology and ENT services across Worcestershire County Audiology, working within agreed competency frameworks, departmental protocols and clinical guidelines to provide safe, effective and patient-centred care.

The postholder will organise their own workload within agreed protocols whilst accessing senior clinical advice and supervision as required. They will work flexibly across service locations and may contribute to delegated clinical activity within adult, paediatric and community pathways where appropriately trained, competency assessed and supervised.
The role includes contributing to clinical governance, audit, quality improvement and health and safety activities. ---
## About Modem
Modem Intelligence Ltd builds artificial intelligence software for freight forwarders.
Freight forwarding still runs on legacy transport management systems, spreadsheets and email. Producing a single customer quote can take a sales team several hours, and independent research covering 86 forwarders found that only 31% of inbound quote requests received any response at all.
Our platform automates that work. It reads inbound quote requests, rate sheets and shipping documents, whatever format they arrive in, and turns them into structured, priceable data. It is in daily commercial use at a UK freight forwarder today, with further customers in contract discussions, and we have signed a term sheet with an institutional investor to fund the next stage of the product.
We are a team of three based in London Bankside. This is an early role with genuine scope.
## The role
You will own the artificial intelligence components of our platform: the systems that turn messy commercial documents into accurate structured data, and the software that surrounds them.
This is a hands on engineering role. It is not a research position and it is not a management position.
## What you will do
* Design and build the AI systems that parse inbound quote requests, rate sheets and shipping documentation, converting unstructured emails, PDFs and images into structured data the platform can price against.
* Build the retrieval and context layers that supply our language models with accurate customer, rate and shipment data, including the schemas, storage and retrieval logic that keep factual state outside the model.
* Design and run evaluation harnesses that measure AI accuracy against labelled datasets, and use the results to drive model, prompt and architecture changes.
* Write production back end software, including APIs, data pipelines and integrations with carrier, rate and customer systems.
* Build the deterministic controls around model output: validation, guardrails, fallback logic and audit logging, so that pricing decisions are traceable and reproducible.
* Write automated tests, take part in code review, and document what you build.
* Work with our CTO on technical direction, and translate customer requirements into shipped software.
## What we are looking for
* A degree at bachelor’s level or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related numerate subject, or equivalent professional software engineering experience.
* At least two years of commercial experience building and shipping production software, including back end development, API integration and data pipeline work.
* Demonstrable experience building applications on large language models in production, including prompt design, evaluation methodology, and separating model driven reasoning from deterministic code and stored data.
* Working knowledge of Python and TypeScript, relational databases and cloud deployment.
* Comfortable gathering technical requirements directly from non technical business users.
* Fluent written and spoken English.
**Desirable, not essential:** familiarity with freight forwarding, logistics or a comparable operational industry.
## What we offer
* Salary of GBP 50,000 to GBP 55,000, with a contractual salary review on completion of our next funding round.
* Share options under an EMI scheme, vesting over four years.
* 25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays.
* Workplace pension.
* Equipment and learning budgets.
* An office in London Bankside and a small team you will help shape.
## How to apply
Send your CV and a short note on a system you have built with large language models in production to **claudiu@thinkmodem.com**.
We review applications as they arrive and will respond to everyone who applies. Applications close on Wednesday 23 September 2026.

\* Takes disciplinary action against players guilty of cautionable and sending-off offences.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**
Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.
You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:
* Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
* Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
* Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
* Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
* Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
* Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
* Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
* Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
* Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
* Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
### WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
* Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
* Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development
* Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
* Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
* Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

## Lead, Business Development & Licensing - Sureel AI

### **A little bit about our team**
Sureel AI is building the standards and infrastructure for AI rights, licensing, attribution, protection, and intelligence, starting in music and expanding across media.
We are building the infrastructure that enables creators and rights holders to control how their work is used by AI, protect their rights, understand its use and value, and participate in new AI licensing models. We also provide AI companies and digital platforms with the systems they need to access rights, permissions, attribution, guardrails, reporting, and licensing infrastructure programmatically.
Acquired by Warner Music Group, Sureel operates as an independent, federated company, combining startup speed with the reach of a global music company.
Our commercial relationships sit at the heart of what we're building: with the AI companies and digital service providers (DSPs) who integrate our attribution infrastructure into their platforms, and with the rights holders whose works and interests that infrastructure protects. As Director, Business Development & Licensing, you'll own the business function across both sides of that equation, working closely with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners across the music, technology, and legal worlds. Your work will directly shape the commercial architecture of AI attribution at scale.
### **Your role**
You will lead Sureel's business function, reporting to the CEO and two Co-Presidents. This is a senior, commercially focused role. When Sureel is negotiating with a service provider or a rights holder, you will own the business function of that negotiation.
You will also serve as Sureel's primary liaison with industry bodies such as DDEX and regulatory bodies such as WIPO where their activities relate to Sureel's business.
A key part of the role will be developing business models and modeling outcomes for charging clients, including DSPs and AI companies. A strong understanding of economics and music rights will be important.
Your objective is to structure agreements that increase adoption of Sureel's infrastructure, create repeatable commercial models, and establish frameworks that can scale across multiple rights holders, AI companies, and markets.
You will negotiate licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and the economic frameworks that determine how permissions through Sureel's technology translate into compensation. You will also oversee the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining what a commercially viable integration looks like and structuring the terms around it.
You'll work closely with Product and Client Relations. They will bring the product and partner perspectives, while you will lead the commercial structure and economics that support the business.
This is an opportunity to help define the business function of a company working in a new and evolving area, and to help shape how creators are compensated in the age of AI.
### What you'll do:
* **Own the business function for Sureel's negotiations**, whether with AI companies, DSPs, other digital service providers, or rights holders, leading commercial strategy, deal structure, and terms from first conversation through signature.
* **Negotiate the economics of platform integrations**, including licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and frameworks that reflect the value of Sureel's technology alongside rights holders' catalog and distribution positions.
* **Develop the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure** with AI companies and DSPs, defining commercial success and prioritizing opportunities based on enterprise value.
* **Develop licensing and economic frameworks for an emerging category**, using relevant AI and rights-technology transactions to inform agreements that can work across different partners and markets.
* **Structure multi-stakeholder commercial arrangements** among rights holders and industry participants, positioning Sureel's infrastructure as the mechanism for executing those agreements.
* **Partner with Client Relations on rights-holder relationships**, owning the commercial terms and deal economics while they lead the broader relationship and delivery.
* **Work closely with Warner Music Group counterparts** on commercial terms, licensing structures, and strategic priorities.
* **Provide market intelligence** on emerging technologies, competitive developments, licensing innovation, and deal dynamics across the AI and DSP landscape.
* **Represent Sureel with industry and standards organizations**, including DDEX, WIPO, and other initiatives shaping AI rights and licensing.
* **Develop pricing and packaging for Sureel's platform**, including enterprise fees, API and usage-based pricing, transaction fees, revenue share, licensing administration, analytics, and hybrid structures.
* **Create repeatable commercial and licensing frameworks** that can scale across partners rather than requiring every agreement to be built from scratch.
* **Help structure how Sureel infrastructure is used in commercial agreements**, including rights, permissions, guardrails, attribution, reporting, and economic obligations between rights holders and AI companies.
* **Handle confidential and proprietary information,** including deal terms, partner economics, and negotiations with discretion and integrity.
* **Help shape emerging industry standards and licensing frameworks** so they can be implemented programmatically and work with Sureel's architecture.
### Who you are:
* You have deep experience structuring and negotiating commercial agreements in **music, media, or technology**, including licensing deals, platform integrations, revenue-share structures, or rights-technology transactions.
* You've owned the business side of negotiations with platforms, DSPs, technology companies, or rights holders and carried complex deals from term sheet through signature.
* You understand the economics of the music industry: how rights generate revenue, how licensing frameworks are built, and how value flows between platforms, intermediaries, and rights holders.
* You're comfortable with data and financial detail. You can model a revenue structure, pressure-test assumptions, and explain the business logic clearly to technical teams and senior counterparties.
* You can structure complex deals and find approaches that work for the different parties involved.
* You build trust quickly and can represent leadership in high-stakes negotiations, make judgment calls on terms, and know when to escalate.
* You communicate clearly in writing and in person and can stay calm in a fast-moving environment.
* You understand how pricing, licensing structures, technical standards, and ecosystem incentives can support platform adoption and durable commercial outcomes.
* You are interested in the music industry and enjoy working in a small, collaborative, startup-paced team.
### We'd love it if you also had:
* Direct experience negotiating with AI companies, DSPs, or other digital service providers on licensing, integration, or commercial partnership terms.
* Experience working with artists, labels, publishers, or CMOs/PROs on the commercial side, or serving as a senior deal advisor to them.
* Experience across deal structuring and licensing, business development, commercial strategy, or partnerships.
* Involvement in industry licensing, standards, or policy initiatives shaping how AI and rights interact.
* Experience working directly with C-level executives on commercial strategy, negotiation preparation, and translating senior conversations into agreements.
* Experience developing commercial models for infrastructure, APIs, marketplaces, payments, rights technology, or other platforms where value is monetized across multiple layers of a transaction.
* Curiosity about the music and entertainment landscape and AI's impact on creators.

# Apply for Staff Research Scientist, Reinforce Learning London, United Kingdom full time on-site Wayve Labs
## **About us**
Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.
Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.
In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.
At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.
Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!
### **The Role**
We’re looking for Research Scientists to join Wayve Labs and help build the next generation of AI systems for autonomous driving. You’ll work at the intersection of machine learning, simulation, robotics, and real-world deployment, contributing to core innovations that push the boundaries of embodied AI.
Situated within Wayve, we are a high-conviction research team with the strategic patience and backing to prioritise multi-year breakthroughs over incremental gains. We are looking for highly motivated individuals with expertise and passion to push the frontier of embodied AI, including (but not limited to) the following areas:
**World & Reward Modeling:** Building realistic, diverse simulators that can predict the consequences and costs of actions.
**Representation Learning & Spatial Intelligence:** Advancing how machines truly understand and navigate dynamic, unstructured 3D environments, from detailed spatial understanding, to efficient long term memory.
**Scalable Decision-Making Systems:** Designing architectures, reasoning systems, and policy learning algorithms that operate over long contexts, and scale with data and compute.
**Cross-Embodiment and Multimodal Learning:** Advance embodied learning systems that can flexibly adapt to diverse robotic platforms and multimodal inputs, using vision, language, and active sensors.
### **Key Responsibilities**
* Develop World Models and Planners (e.g., diffusion-based, autoregressive, or hybrid approaches) for realistic and consistent simulation
* Advance Reinforcement Learning and Reward Modeling, building scalable and safe learning frameworks across real and synthetic data
* Develop Geometric Foundation Models for 3D spatial understanding in dynamic, real-world environments.
* Enable Cross-Embodiment Robotics, leveraging the power of multimodal foundation models to accelerate robotic learning on diverse platforms.
* Conduct empirical research on Scaling laws, Generalisation, and Sim-to-real transfer
* Define and evolve Evaluation Frameworks and Benchmarks for long-horizon prediction, scene fidelity, and driving performance
### **What You’ll Bring**
Must-haves:
* 3+ years of experience developing and deploying ML systems in real-world or production settings
* PhD, Master’s degree, or equivalent experience in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Robotics, or a related field
* Deep expertise in one or more core Embodied AI areas, such as:
* Foundation models (e.g., transformers, MoE, large-scale training)
* Generative world modeling (e.g., diffusion, autoregressive, hybrid approaches)
* Reinforcement learning (e.g., offline RL, RLHF, reward modeling)
* Spatial AI (e.g., SLAM/SfM, depth estimation, multi-view geometry with multimodal sensors)
* Track record of publications at top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, CoRL)
* Strong programming skills in Python, with experience using frameworks such as PyTorch
* A data-centric mindset, with experience working on large-scale datasets and evaluation
* Strong problem-solving ability and the ability to collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary teams
Nice-to-haves:
* Experience in autonomous driving, robotics, or simulation systems
* Familiarity with large-scale training (e.g., FSDP, DeepSpeed, JAX)
* Experience with sim-to-real transfer or data-efficient learning
* Contributions to open-source ML tools or research infrastructure
## **What we offer you**
* Attractive compensation with salary and equity
* Immersion in a team of world-class researchers, engineers and entrepreneurs
* A unique position to shape the future of autonomy and tackle the biggest challenge of our time
* Bespoke learning and development opportunities
* Relocation support with visa sponsorship
* Flexible working hours - we trust you to do your job well, at times that suit you and your time
* Benefits such as an onsite chef, workplace nursery scheme, private health insurance, therapy, daily yoga, onsite bar, large social budgets, unlimited L&D requests, enhanced parental leave, and more!
This is a full-time role based in our office in London. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home.
Wayve is committed to creating an inclusive interview experience. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to participate fully in our interview process, please let us know.
We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.
At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

Working closely with our Asset Investment Manager, Sustainability Lead and Head of Asset Strategy, you'll play a key role in translating complex information into meaningful intelligence that supports business planning and strategic decision-making.
